jobs.title: Software Integration Developer
jobs.description:
Interested in designing the integrations behind business-critical systems? Join an international team developing APIs, backend services, and Azure-based solutions that enable digital transformation.

Drive meaningful change

As our new Software Integration Developer, you will develop and maintain backend applications, APIs, and integration services that support critical processes across Abacus Medicine Group.

Working with Microsoft Azure and the .NET ecosystem, you will design solutions that enable reliable communication between systems and applications. You will also contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions, combining hands-on development with a broader view of our system landscape.

Your Main Responsibilities Include

Developing and maintaining backend applications, APIs, and integration services
Designing secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions aligned with our platform architecture and integration standards
Building and supporting APIs that enable reliable communication between systems and business applications
Developing reusable backend services and integration components
Working with databases and cloud-native services to ensure performance, reliability, and data integrity
Participating in technical design discussions, code reviews, and architecture decisions
Collaborating with developers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions
Monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuously improving business-critical applications and integrations
Contributing to development standards, shared technical assets, and best practices
Supporting knowledge sharing and mentoring less experienced colleagues

Our Technology Landscape Includes

Backend: .NET, C#, SQL, and Cosmos DB
Integration: REST APIs, SOAP, Azure Service Bus, API Management, and Logic Apps
Cloud: Microsoft Azure, including App Services and Function Apps
Security: OAuth2 and JWT
DevOps: Azure DevOps CI/CD and ARM Templates/Bicep
Methodology: Agile

Your Profile

You have a strong background in backend and integration development, combining hands-on technical expertise with an architectural mindset. You translate business requirements into robust solutions, collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, and take a structured, proactive approach to improving systems and ways of working.

We Imagine You Have

A Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
Approximately 5 years of experience developing backend applications, APIs, and integrations
Solid experience with .NET, C#, SQL, and Microsoft Azure
Experience designing scalable, maintainable, and secure backend solutions in cloud environments
Experience with Azure services such as App Services, Function Apps, Logic Apps, API Management, and Service Bus
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment tooling, preferably Azure DevOps
Familiarity with integration patterns, event-driven architectures, distributed systems, and microservices
Strong communication skills and professional proficiency in English

Be part of an international community of people who care

You will join our growing Integrations & Power Platform team, with developers based in Denmark, the Netherlands, and Hungary. The team develops and maintains integrations, backend services, and business-critical platforms across the organisation.

You will collaborate with Digital Application teams, Operations, QA, business stakeholders, and external software vendors and technology partners. Knowledge sharing and technical collaboration are central to the team, and you will have the opportunity to influence how we design and develop our solutions.

Interested?

If you want to apply for the position, please follow the link and attach your CV.

If you have any further questions about the role, please do not hesitate to contact the Talent Acquisition Partner, Victor, at victor.weyen@abacusmedicine.com.

Would you like to know more about us?

Follow us on Instagram and LinkedIn and get an insight into everyday life at Abacus Medicine. For job openings, check our Career page.

Moving Healthcare. Moving You.

In Abacus Medicine Group, you’ll experience the power of Moving Healthcare. With our change mindset, we're moving the industry and improving healthcare as we broaden access to medicine.

But it's not just about moving healthcare, it's about Moving You. You’ll be part of a caring community of around 2,000 people across the World. With us, you will be valued, empowered, and have a direct impact on driving change. Let's access the future of medicine and make a difference together. Your move.

jobs.title: Full-stack developer GLASS
jobs.description:
Wil je deel uitmaken van een Agile productteam dat complexe uitdagingen in het onderwijs aanpakt? Als full-stack developer bij ICT Services van de Universiteit van Amsterdam en Hogeschool van Amsterdam, werk je samen met jouw collega's aan innovatieve oplossingen voor studieplanning, waardoor studenten hun academische traject effectiever kunnen beheren.

Werken bij de UvA

Kom bij ons werken

Als full-stack developer ben je binnen het productteam GLASS verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van het nieuwe product STUDIEPLAN. Er wordt gebruik gemaakt van .NET in de back-end en React + TypeScript in de front-end, waarbij de communicatie tussen de twee op basis van GraphQL plaatsvindt. Er wordt gebruik gemaakt van de Apollo Client in een omgeving die is gebouwd volgens het CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) patroon. Als team zijn we verantwoordelijk voor het volledig functioneren van onze oplossingen, en we hanteren het principe 'you build it, you run it'. Ook ben je betrokken bij het ontwerpen en opzetten van geautomatiseerde tests met rapportages.

Een goed salaris Je salaris wordt bepaald op basis van jouw ervaring en senioriteit, conform de CAO Universiteiten. Je inschaling en dus de genoemde bedragen zijn gebaseerd op een volledig dienstverband van 38 uur per week.
232 vakantie-uren Ook bieden we ouderschapsverlof, partnerverlof en verlof wegens maatschappelijke betrokkenheid. Via de Menukaart Arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn er mogelijkheden tot nog meer vakantie-uren.
Financiële regelingen Bovenop je salaris ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,3%). Je bouwt een goed pensioen op bij het ABP. En daarnaast bieden we nog veel meer tegemoetkomingen en regelingen.
Loopbaanontwikkeling en ruimte voor groei De UvA stimuleert jou om je blijvend te professionaliseren d.m.v. trainingen en open UvA-colleges.
Flexibiliteit Je hebt de flexibiliteit om werk en privé te combineren, vaak met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken.

Alles over deze vacature

Dit ga je doen

Denk hierbij aan de volgende werkzaamheden:

De ontwikkeling van het nieuwe STUDIEPLAN-product binnen het GLASS-productteam;
Uitwerken van functionele eisen en technische oplossingen, programmeren van nieuwe systeemdelen, testen, analyseren van testresultaten en foutcorrectie;
Ontwerpen en implementeren van geautomatiseerde tests met bijbehorende rapportages.

Dit vragen we van jou

Wij zoeken een ervaren professional die:

Back-end vereisten:

Ervaring in C# en de nieuwste versies van .NET (minimaal 5 jaar);
Ervaring met verschillende ontwikkeltools, zoals Docker en Git;
Ervaring met Azure, IaC, Kubernetes, Terraform en GitOps;
Ervaring met micro services;
Ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van schaalbare API’s; specifieke ervaring met GraphQL is een sterke pre.

Front-end vereisten:

Ervaring met front-end frameworks; specifieke ervaring met React is een pre;
Ervaring met TypeScript;
Kennis van gebruik van GraphQL API’s met de Apollo client;
Je schrijft graag zelf CSS;
Kennis van module federation voor micro frontends is een pre.

Algemeen profiel:

Bekendheid met agile ontwikkelingsmethodieken;
Professionele beheersing van de Nederlandse taal maar je hoeft geen native speaker te zijn;
Passie voor het vinden van technische oplossingen en het leveren van kwaliteit;
Zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid in het beheer van applicaties en releases;
Ervaring met het opzetten van complexe web applicaties.

Dit bieden we jou nog meer

Een dynamische en creatieve werkomgeving waar je veel ruimte krijgt voor individuele inbreng en waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd!

Deze functie past binnen het functieprofiel IT-IV Engineering and Application Manager 1 of 2. Bij deze functie hoort schaal 11 of 12. Het salaris bedraagt minimaal €4.925,- en maximaal €7.573,- bruto per maand bij een volledig dienstverband (38 uur per week) exclusief vakantiegeld (8%) en eindejaarsuitkering (8,3%) en is afhankelijk van competenties en ervaring. De cao Nederlandse Universiteiten is van toepassing.

De UvA heeft een uitgebreid pakket secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:

29 vakantiedagen bij een volledig dienstverband & extra vakantiedagen tussen kerst en de jaarwisseling;
Mobiele telefoon en een laptop;
Internet- en thuiswerkvergoeding;
Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP;
Je hebt de flexibiliteit om werk en privé te combineren, met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken;
Door wekelijks twee uur meer te werken dan je contracturen, ontvang je op jaarbasis 96 compensatie-uren. Dat geldt ook als je parttimer bent;
Daarnaast biedt de UvA uitstekende studie- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en stimuleert medewerkers om zich blijvend te professionaliseren;
Ook kun je deelnemen aan Open UvA-Colleges om je verder te ontwikkelen en je horizon te verbreden. De UvA vergoedt de kosten hiervoor binnen de daarvoor geldende regeling.

Het betreft een fulltime dienstverband voor 38 uur per week. We bieden een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst voor een jaar met uitzicht op een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd. Je standplaats wordt Hogehilweg 21, Amsterdam.

Nieuwsgierig naar onze organisatie en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een ruime vakantieregeling en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Hier lees je meer over werken bij de Universiteit van Amsterdam. Voor de HvA, zie medewerkers aan het woord.

Jouw plek bij de UvA

In dit team / bij deze afdeling kom je te werken

De Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA) leveren kwalitatief hoogwaardig onderwijs en onderzoek. Zonder ICT zijn de 90.000 studenten en 10.000 medewerkers van de HvA en UvA nergens. Niet voor niets werken er ruim 300 professionals bij de centrale dienst ICT Services (ICTS). Van het leveren van ICT-middelen tot het onderhouden van de technische infrastructuur, en van het ontwikkelen van apps tot gebruikersondersteuning via de servicedesk: ons takenpakket is superbreed. Je kunt dus alle kanten op.

We werken aan complexe technische uitdagingen zoals cloud computing, big data en machine learning. En als het gaat om cybersecurity, dan loopt onze ICT-organisatie landelijk voorop. Wat jouw werk nog meer zo boeiend maakt, is dat je bijdraagt aan onderwijs en onderzoek. Daarin werken we aan de beste combinatie tussen innoveren en kwaliteit. Kortom, je blijft up-to-date en hebt een baan met maatschappelijke impact. Meer lezen

Afdeling Applicatiebeheer, Team GLASS

Welkom bij het GLASS team, waar innovatie en samenwerking samenkomen. In team GLASS krijg je de kans om een significante impact te hebben op de toekomst van onderwijsvoorbereiding en technologische vooruitgang. Ons team is vastberaden om de volgende doelstellingen te verwezenlijken:

Onze uitdaging is het bouwen van het nieuwe en complexe STUDIEPLAN en het tegelijkertijd verbeteren en uitbreiden van de huidige functionaliteit van de GLASS-applicatie;
Studenten ondersteunen bij succesvolle studieplanning en vakaanmelding. Een zorgeloze ervaring van begin tot eind van de studie;
Faculteiten faciliteren op gebied van onderwijsvoorbereiding en ondersteuning bij de uitvoering van het onderwijs;
Wij zijn toegewijd aan het verbeteren van onze ontwikkelprocessen door de implementatie van Continuous Integration en Continuous Delivery. Dit stelt ons in staat om onze softwareontwikkeling sneller en met hogere kwaliteit uit te voeren, wat bijdraagt aan een efficiënte werkomgeving;
Innovatie is een kernwaarde voor ons. We innoveren voortdurend om ervoor te zorgen dat studenten kunnen studeren met behulp van geavanceerde technologieën en processen.

Binnen ons hechte GLASS-team vind je een groep van gedreven professionals. Je werkt zij aan zij met 3 back-end developers, 2 front-end developers, 1 functioneel beheerder, 2 UX/UI Designers, en een product owner. Het team werkt 2 dagen (dinsdagen en donderdagen) op kantoor in Amsterdam-Zuidoost en 3 dagen vanuit huis. We koesteren open communicatie en bevorderen constructieve discussies, omdat we geloven dat dit de basis vormt voor groei en succes. Word lid van ons team en speel een cruciale rol in het vormgeven van de toekomst van onderwijslogistiek en technologische innovatie. Jouw bijdrage zal een blijvende impact hebben op studenten terwijl je samen met ons bouwt aan een betere onderwijservaring.

Voor meer informatie zie onze LinkedIn-pagina Universiteit van Amsterdam: Werken in de ICT en de websites www.hva.nl en www.uva.nl.

Past deze vacature niet bij jouw profiel? We hebben nog meer vacatures!

Kijk hiervoor bij de vacatures van ICTS bij de HvA  en de UvA .

Bij de werving en selectie ter invulling van deze vacature houden wij de UvA Sollicitatiecode aan.

Bij ICTS hechten we veel waarde aan integriteit en kwalificaties. Als onderdeel van ons sollicitatieproces voeren wij een controle uit om de betrouwbaarheid en geschiktheid van onze kandidaten te waarborgen door een identiteitscontrole en diploma- en referentiechecks.

Meer over de UvA

De Universiteit van Amsterdam is ambitieus, creatief en betrokken. Sinds 1632 een inspiratie voor studenten, een voorhoedespeler in de internationale wetenschap en een partner in vernieuwing.

De Universiteit van Amsterdam is de grootste universiteit van Nederland, met het breedste opleidingsaanbod. Een intellectueel knooppunt met 44.000 studenten, 6.000 medewerkers en 3.000 promovendi. Verbonden door een cultuur van nieuwsgierigheid.

Belangrijk om te weten

Jouw sollicitatie & contact

Is dit de baan voor jou en word jij onze nieuwe collega? Wij zijn benieuwd naar jou!

Klik bovenin op deze pagina op de knop “solliciteer” om direct te solliciteren.

Wil je eerst nog even verder praten over jouw misschien wel toekomstige werkzaamheden? Neem dan contact op met:

Joshua Bonsink, Solution Architect, via j.c.bonsink@uva.nl.

(Gebruik dit emailadres uitsluitend voor het stellen van vragen; we verwerken alleen sollicitaties die we ontvangen via de sollicitatieknop onderaan deze vacature).

Heb je nog vragen over je sollicitatie of het proces? Neem dan gerust contact op met:

Jacqueline Bet, Recruiter ICTS, via 06-14365658 of per e-mail j.bet@uva.nl.

Ook belangrijk!

Bij gelijke geschiktheid krijgen interne kandidaten voorrang.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Daar gaan we niet op in.

Als werkgever hanteert de UvA een beleid van gelijke kansen. We vinden diversiteit belangrijk en zetten ons volledig in om een plek te zijn waar iedereen zich thuis voelt. We koesteren de onderzoekende geest en het doorzettingsvermogen en laten ruimte om door te vragen. Bij ons vormen nieuwsgierigheid en creativiteit de heersende cultuur.

Let op! Voor deze vacature communiceren wij een (uiterste) sluitingsdatum. Echter, bij de ontvangst van passende of aansluitende sollicitaties zullen er al vóór de sluitingsdatum sollicitatiegesprekken plaatsvinden. Bij gebleken geschiktheid kan dit eventueel betekenen dat de vacature vervuld wordt vóór het verstrijken van de gecommuniceerde uiterste sluitingsdatum.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Diversiteit en inclusie

Als werkgever handhaaft de UvA een beleid van gelijke kansen. We vinden diversiteit belangrijk en zetten ons volledig in om een plek te zijn waar iedereen zich thuis voelt. We koesteren de onderzoekende geest en het doorzettingsvermogen en laten de ruimte om door te vragen. Bij ons vormen nieuwsgierigheid en creativiteit de heersende cultuur.

Studies tonen aan dat vrouwen en leden van ondervertegenwoordigde groepen alleen solliciteren naar banen als ze aan 100% van de kwalificaties voldoen. Voldoe jij wel aan de opleidingseisen maar heb je nog niet alle gevraagde ervaring? Dan moedigt de UvA je aan om toch te solliciteren.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About This Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.
Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.
Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.
Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.
Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.
Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.
Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.
The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What You Will Need

5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.
Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.
Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.
Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.
Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.
A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.
Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.
Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.
Fluency in English is a must.

What We Offer

Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.
Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.
A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.
Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.
We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
TOPdesk builds service management software used across education, healthcare, government, and manufacturing. We are 700+ colleagues in 11 offices worldwide. Founded over 30 years ago, we serve more than 10 million users worldwide and have been helping organisations deliver better services ever since.

We are an open, collaborative organisation with little hierarchy — people own their work end to end and are trusted to make the decisions that matter. We are reinventing ITSM and ESM for the agentic era, building AI agents our customers can trust, and this role is part of that.

Job Description

About the role

As an Engineering Manager, you lead one or two teams with a specific technical mission — front-end, middleware, back-end, data, or platform — giving both people and technical direction, and owning what your teams ship.

You set team-level technical direction within the wider architectural guardrails, grow strong engineers into stronger ones, and own delivery and operational outcomes — creating the conditions for your senior and staff engineers to provide technical leadership too. You operate agents yourself and lead our AI-native SDLC from the front. You report to your domain's senior engineering leader.

What this is not A purely process or Scrum-master role, or a hands-off manager who sets no technical direction. You lead people and technology together, and stay technically close through design, pairing, incident response, reviews, technical investigation, and agent workflows — regular individual coding output is not the measure of the role.

The team

You lead one or two teams with a specific mission — for example front-end feature development, middleware, back-end services, data, or platform.

Delivers its part of the domain's roadmap.
Sets and upholds the technical standards for its domain.
Adopts the target architecture and our AI-native SDLC practices.
Sits within a approx 170-strong engineering organisation across Delft, Budapest, and Kaiserslautern.

What you'll do

Provide technical direction

Set technical direction and standards for your teams' domain, alongside your engineers.
Make and steward the key technical decisions; uphold quality, security, and operational stability.
Contribute to system and architecture decisions for your domain with the Enterprise Architects and your peers.

Grow the people

Coach and develop your engineers — including growing strong ones into senior and staff engineers.
Hire, and act on tough talent calls with clarity and care.

Own the delivery and the bar

Own your teams' roadmap commitments and delivery and operational outcomes; protect cycle time, quality, and operational stability.
Keep review sustainable in an agentic SDLC — ensure your teams do not create excessive review burden or unnecessary code, match agent autonomy to the risk of the task, and keep human accountability clear.
Raise the engineering bar for your domain; make standards explicit and inspectable.
Operate agents yourself — build the subagents, evals, and patterns your team reuses, and contribute them back to the shared libraries.

Technical environment

Claude Code is our current primary agentic engineering environment: agents may plan and execute within defined constraints and governed environments, while engineers stay accountable for problem framing, architecture, acceptance criteria, security, verification, and production outcomes. Agent-generated work is backed by automated tests, runtime checks, reviewable evidence, and risk-based human approval — we match deterministic automation, structured workflows, or agents to the nature and risk of the task rather than maximising autonomy for its own sake.

Your domain: front-end, middleware, back-end, data, or platform — the specific stack depends on your teams' mission.
Legacy: Java, MS SQL, heritage architecture — being decomposed.
Modern: Python, TypeScript, Vue, Postgres, Azure, Kubernetes; cloud-native / service-oriented architecture; Terraform-managed infrastructure.
Mechanisms: subagents, MCP tool integrations, multi-agent workflows, and shared prompt, agent, and eval libraries.

Success in your first year

Your teams reliably deliver their part of the domain's roadmap, with measurably better cycle time, quality, and stability.
Technical direction and standards for your domain are clear, owned, and upheld — the bar has gone up.
Your engineers have grown, including movement into senior or staff roles.
AI-native ways of working are normal in your team, with patterns and evals you contributed.

Qualifications

Required

Engineering manager with a track record of growing engineers — including into senior and staff roles — and owning team delivery.
A strong technical foundation in a relevant domain (front-end, middleware, back-end, data, or platform) — you set team-level technical direction, not just run process.
Current, personal practice of AI-native software delivery (Claude Code or equivalent) — you can show your work and lead by example.
Strong on talent development; comfortable acting on tough calls.
Comfortable in ambiguity and inside legacy codebases; a strong communicator.

Nice to have

Led a team through a significant technical or operating-model change.
Has built and shared subagents, evals, or CLAUDE.md conventions a team reused.
Deep domain expertise relevant to one of the product domains.

Additional Information

What's in it for you

A strong focus on personal development — including, in the Netherlands, our “10 to Grow” programme: 10% of your time and budget for your own growth.
A hybrid working environment built on freedom, trust, and responsibility.
An open, informal, and supportive culture, with collaboration across national borders.
Excellent employment conditions.

Want to apply?

Does this sound like your next step? Apply with your CV and a short motivation letter via the application form. Tell us, with an example, how you gave both people and technical direction to a team — and what it shipped as a result.

jobs.title: Intern Application Developer 2027 - ServiceNow
jobs.description:
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. To give yourself the best opportunity for success, we advise applying only to roles that align with your skills and experience, rather than applying broadly across all entry-level positions. You'll receive a status update email for each application, so be sure to check your IBM Careers account regularly — it's the best way to get a centralized view of which roles you have active applications against. During your internship, you can enhance your knowledge and gain professional experience by working on client projects. This role provides an exceptional opportunity to build a compelling portfolio, acquire new skills, gain insights into diverse industries, and embrace novel challenges for your future career.

At IBM, we prioritize continuous learning, skill development, and personal growth within a culture of coaching and mentorship. As an intern, you'll experience this culture and could advance to our full-time Associates program based on results and performance.

Work Experiences You Could Be Exposed To

Team Collaboration and Innovation: Join cross functional teams to understand requirements and define technical specs for various projects, fostering collaboration innovation. Precision in Documentation: Document technical specifications and design decisions with clarity ensuring effective communication within the team and stakeholders.

Code Excellence: develop scalable reusable code and champion code review processes/tools to uphold top notch code quality. Full Stack Versatility: Engage in full stack cloud native development, utilizing design thinking to create products that prioritize user experience, performance, security, quality, and stability. jobs.description:
Description

BESCHREIBUNG:

Wir suchen einen motivierten Full-Stack Developer (C#/.NET & Angular) zur Verstärkung unseres dynamischen Produkt- und Entwicklungsteams.

ÜBER Freicon

Freicon Software GmbH, ein Unternehmen der Valsoft Corporation, entwickelt und liefert moderne Dealer-Management-Systeme (DMS), die speziell auf die Anforderungen der Automobil-, Nutzfahrzeug- und Caravan-Branche zugeschnitten sind. Unser Flaggschiffprodukt FILAKS.PLUS unterstützt Autohäuser bei der Steuerung sämtlicher Geschäftsprozesse – von Kundenservice und Lagerlogistik bis hin zum Fahrzeugverkauf.

Über Valsoft Corp

Valsoft wurde 2015 in Kanada gegründet und ist mittlerweile auf ein globales Portfolio von über 118 Unternehmen gewachsen. Wir erwerben und entwickeln vertikal spezialisierte Softwareunternehmen, um unseren Kunden in verschiedenen Branchen die besten geschäftskritischen Lösungen bereitzustellen.

Ein zentraler Bestandteil der Valsoft-Philosophie ist es, in etablierte Unternehmen zu investieren und ein unternehmerisches Umfeld zu fördern, das diese zu führenden Anbietern in ihren Märkten macht. Wir kaufen, halten und schaffen langfristigen Wert durch Partnerschaften mit bestehenden Managementteams.

Investitionsstrategie

Im Gegensatz zu Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Firmen sind wir Unternehmer, die Softwareunternehmen erwerben, weiterentwickeln und nachhaltig ausbauen. Richtig gelesen – wir verkaufen keine Unternehmen. Stattdessen gehen wir strategische Partnerschaften mit bestehenden Managementteams ein. Wir schätzen die Hingabe und Ausdauer, die zum Aufbau eines Unternehmens erforderlich sind, und stellen das Wohl unserer Kunden und Mitarbeiter über kurzfristige Ziele.

Unternehmenskultur

Valsoft ist mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz wir sind ein Team. Unsere Mitarbeiter sind unser wertvollstes Kapital, und ihre Weiterentwicklung hat für uns höchste Priorität. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem unsere Mitarbeitenden jeden Tag dieselbe Begeisterung wie am ersten Arbeitstag verspüren.

Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von Leistungsstärke, Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Unterstützung. Wir feiern unsere Erfolge – und sind stolz darauf. Wir träumen groß, bleiben bescheiden und bleiben hungrig.

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Full-Stack Developer bist Du der Mensch, der das baut, was das Geschäft wirklich braucht: neue Produkt-Features, Integrationen und interne Systeme. Du arbeitest sowohl am Backend mit C#/.NET als auch am Frontend mit Angular und entwickelst unsere Kernplattform kontinuierlich weiter. Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt, Vertrieb und unseren Kunden zusammen, verstehst FILAKS.PLUS und die zugrunde liegende Architektur und baust zuverlässige Lösungen, die das Geschäft nach vorne bringen.

Hauptaufgaben

Design und Entwicklung von Features und Integrationen für unsere Kernplattform mit C#/.NET im Backend und Angular im Frontend.
Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von FILAKS.PLUS – von der technischen Konzeption bis zum produktiven Einsatz bei unseren Autohaus-Kunden.
Mitarbeit an AI-gestützten Features, Agents und Integrationen als ergänzender Bestandteil unserer Produktentwicklung.
Zusammenarbeit mit Produkt- und Vertriebs-Teams, um Business-Probleme in saubere technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.
End-to-End-Verantwortung: Scoping, Bauen, Ausliefern, Messen, Iterieren.
Aktive Nutzung moderner Entwicklungs- und AI-Coding-Workflows (Claude Code, Cursor o. Ä.), um mit kleinem Team schnell und qualitativ zu shippen.
Schnelle Einarbeitung in FILAKS.PLUS und unsere bestehende Architektur mit dem Ziel, frühzeitig produktionsreife C#/.NET- und Angular-Features auszuliefern.

We are seeking a motivated Full-Stack Developer to join our dynamic product and development team.

About Freicon

Freicon Software GmbH, part of Valsoft Corporation, develops and delivers advanced Dealer Management Systems (DMS) tailored to the specific needs of the automotive, commercial vehicle, and caravan industries. Our flagship product FILAKS. PLUS supports dealerships in managing all operational processes – from customer service and warehouse logistics to vehicle sales.

About Valsoft Corp

Established in Canada in 2015, Valsoft has grown to a global portfolio of 118+ companies, acquiring and developing vertical market software companies, enabling each business to deliver the best mission-critical solutions for customers in their respective industries. A key tenet of Valsoft’s philosophy is to invest in well-established businesses and foster an entrepreneurial environment that molds companies into leaders in their respective industries. Valsoft looks to buy, hold, and create value through long-term partnerships with existing management.

Investment Approach

Unlike private equity and venture capital firms, we are Entrepreneurs who Buy, Enhance and Grow Software Businesses. That’s right; we don’t sell businesses. We form a strategic alliance with existing management teams. We recognize the dedication and perseverance required to create a firm and place a premium on customers’ and workers’ well-being over short-term goals.

Culture

Valsoft is more than just a place to work; we’re a team. We mean it when we say people are our greatest assets, so investing in them is our number one priority. We create an environment where our employees feel first-day-on-the-job excitement, day after day, creating a culture of high performers and collaboration. We celebrate our milestones, and we’re proud of them. We Dream Big, Stay Humble, and Stay Hungry.

Position Description

As a Full-Stack Developer, you will be the person who builds what the business actually needs: new product features, integrations and internal systems. You will work across the backend using C#/.NET and the frontend using Angular, continuously developing and improving our core platform.

You will work closely with product, sales and our customers, understand FILAKS.PLUS and its underlying architecture, and build reliable solutions that move the business forward.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop features and integrations for our core platform using C#/.NET on the backend and Angular on the frontend.
Develop and continuously improve FILAKS.PLUS, from technical concept through to production use with our dealership customers.
Contribute to AI-powered features, agents and integrations as a secondary part of our product development.
Work directly with product and sales teams to translate business problems into clean technical solutions.
Own the full delivery cycle: scoping, building, shipping, measuring and iterating.
Use modern development and AI coding workflows (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) to ship quickly and effectively as a small team.
Quickly ramp up on FILAKS.PLUS and our existing architecture, with the goal of delivering production-ready C#/.NET and Angular features early on.

Requirements

Starke Software-Engineering-Grundlagen. Du schreibst sauberen, produktionsreifen Code und verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit C#/.NET im Backend und Angular im Frontend.
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Auslieferung produktionsreifer Full-Stack-Anwendungen mit C#/.NET und Angular.
Erfahrung mit LLMs, Agents oder AI-Tooling in Produktionsumgebungen ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Starke Problem-Framing-Skills. Du verstehst den Business-Need, bevor Du die Tastatur berührst.
Starker Kommunikator. Du kannst technische Entscheidungen für nicht-technische Stakeholder übersetzen und deren Vertrauen gewinnen.
Self-Starter, der schnell ist und Codebases besser hinterlässt, als er sie vorgefunden hat.
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse(mindestens C1 in beiden Sprachen),um mit Kunden in DACH und Kolleginnen und Kollegen in der internationalen Valsoft-Gruppe zu arbeiten.
Strong software development fundamentals. You write clean, production-quality code and have strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET on the backend and Angular on the frontend.
Experience developing and shipping production-grade full-stack applications using C#/.NET and Angular.
Experience with LLMs, agents or AI tooling in production is a nice-to-have, but not a requirement.
Strong problem-framing skills. You understand the business need before you touch the keyboard.
Strong communicator. You can translate technical decisions for non-technical stakeholders and earn their trust.
Self-starter who moves fast and leaves codebases better than you found them.
Fluent in German and English(C1 or better in both), to work with customers in DACH and colleagues across the global Valsoft group.

Benefits

Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit.
Remote-Arbeit innerhalb des DACH-Raums mit gelegentlichen Onsite-Tagen an unserem Standort in Bötzingen.
30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.
Ein Produkt mit echter Marktrelevanz: FILAKS.PLUS wird täglich in Autohäusern in der ganzen DACH-Region genutzt. Dein Code läuft in Produktion, bei echten Kunden.
Rückhalt der globalen Valsoft-Gruppe und Zugang zu deren AI-Infrastruktur und Know-how bei gleichzeitig kurzen Wegen und unternehmerischer Autonomie bei Freicon.
Moderne Tooling-Kultur: Wir erwarten, dass Du in AI-assistierter Entwicklung bereits fließend bist. Nicht neugierig, sondern aktiv damit Deinen Output vervielfachst.
Permanent, full-time employment.
Remote work within the DACH region with occasional onsite days at our office in Bötzingen, Germany.
30 days of paid vacation per year.
A product with real market relevance: FILAKS.PLUS is used daily by dealerships across DACH. Your code runs in production, with real customers.
The backing of the global Valsoft group and access to its AI infrastructure and expertise combined with short decision paths and entrepreneurial autonomy at Freicon.
Modern tooling culture: we expect you to be already fluent in AI-assisted development not curious about it, but actively using it to multiply your output.

Schon heute die Zukunft gestalten – mit Wolters Kluwer

Seit über 180 Jahren unterstützen wir Unternehmen weltweit dabei, Arbeitsprozesse einfacher, effizienter und zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Mit Niederlassungen in über 40 Ländern und Kunden in mehr als 180 Märkten sind wir ein globaler Partner für Fachwissen und Technologie.

Unsere Lösungen verbinden tiefgehendes Know-how mit innovativen Technologien – inklusive moderner KI-Funktionen – und helfen unseren Kunden, ihre größten Herausforderungen erfolgreich zu meistern. Mehr als 21.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, Wissen nutzbar zu machen und Arbeitsprozesse neu zu denken.

Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting (TAA)

Die Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting Deutschland GmbH mit Hauptsitz in Ludwigsburg ist Teil der internationalen Wolters Kluwer Gruppe. Mit über 600 Mitarbeitenden an 10 Standorten in Deutschland entwickeln wir Softwarelösungen wie ADDISON, SBS-Software und AKTE, die Steuerberatungskanzleien und Unternehmen in ganz Europa unterstützen.

Allein in Europa vertrauen mehr als 46.000 Steuerberatungskanzleien sowie über 1,5 Millionen kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen auf unsere Lösungen.

Worum es geht

Du entwickelst die nächste Generation unserer Cloud-Lohnabrechnung und arbeitest Dich in eine der spannendsten und fachlich anspruchsvollsten Domänen des deutschen Softwaremarkts ein.

Bei Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting entwickeln wir ein Produkt, auf das sich Steuerberater und Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland verlassen, wenn es Monat für Monat um korrekte Gehälter, Steuern und Meldungen geht. Dabei erwarten Dich hunderte Lohnarten, ständig neue Gesetze und komplexe Meldeverfahren wie DEÜV, ELSTER und DaBPV. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du dieses Fachwissen bereits mitbringst, sondern dass Du Freude daran hast, Dich in komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten, moderne Softwarelösungen zu entwickeln und mit Werkzeugen wie Claude Code und GitHub Copilot neue Wege zu gehen.

Dein Team

Du arbeitest in einem Team aus Entwickler:innen, Business-Analyst:innen sowie Testautomatisierung. Wir arbeiten in gemeinsamen Sprints, machen regelmäßig Pair Programming und Tech-Demos, und wir probieren KI-Werkzeuge nicht nur aus - wir verwenden sie aktiv in unserem Entwicklungsalltag und binden sie gezielt in unsere Produkte ein.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest Dich in komplexe steuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtliche Anforderungen ein und übersetzt diese gemeinsam mit Fachkolleg:innen in robuste Softwarelösungen.
Du entwickelst Fullstack-Features mit Kotlin und Spring Boot im Backend sowie React im Frontend.
Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code und GitHub Copilot als festen Teil Deines Entwicklungsalltags und hilfst uns, das Zusammenspiel aus KI und Softwareentwicklung weiter auszubauen.
Du bringst Dich in Architektur- und Designentscheidungen ein, hinterfragst konstruktiv und trägst zu konsensfähigen Lösungen bei.
Du sorgst für hohe Qualität - mit testgetriebener Entwicklung, sauberem Code und einem Blick für Sicherheitsthemen in Web-Anwendungen.

Damit begeisterst du uns

Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Fullstack-Entwicklung mit einer objektorientierten Sprache (Java, Kotlin oder C#) und einem modernen Web-Framework für das Frontend (idealerweise React).
Erfahrung mit Spring Boot, Schnittstellen nach REST-Prinzip, SQL-Datenbanken und Cloud Plattformen.
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, sich schnell in neue fachliche Domänen und komplexe Geschäftsprozesse einzuarbeiten.
Praktische Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse am Einsatz von KI-Werkzeugen in der Softwareentwicklung und an modernen Entwicklungsmethoden.
Freude daran, neue Technologien auszuprobieren und die eigene Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch.

Schön wäre außerdem

Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Software für die Lohnabrechnung oder Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Steuerrecht, Sozialversicherung und Meldewesen.
Erfahrung mit Microservices, Event-Sourcing oder CQRS.
Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams (wir arbeiten eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Rumänien zusammen).
Lust, KI nicht nur im Entwicklungsprozess, sondern auch als Produktfeature zu denken und mitzugestalten.
Freude daran, Wissen aktiv zu teilen - Silo-Denken ist nicht unser Ding.

Damit begeistern wir dich

Sichere Zukunft: Du bekommst eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem internationalen Unternehmen sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit persönlicher Beratung.
Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, an dedizierten Tagen mobil zu arbeiten– so passt der Job zu Deinem Leben.
Arbeiten im Ausland: Du kannst bis zu 20 Tage innerhalb von zwölf Monaten flexibel im Ausland arbeiten.
Karriereentwicklung: Wir unterstützen Dich mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Learning on the Job, internationalen Karriereoptionen und internen sowie externen Weiterbildungen.
Gesundheit & Soziales Engagement: Unser Corporate Benefits Programm bietet Dir alles von JobRad über Lebens- und Rentenberatung. Zusätzlich bekommst Du einen zusätzlichen freien Tag, den Volunteer Day, um soziale Projekte zu unterstützen. Mit unserem Programm „Wolters Kluwer hilft“ unterstützen wir als Unternehmen ebenfalls soziale Projekte.
Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Du arbeitest mit leistungsstarker IT-Ausstattung, an modernen Arbeitsplätzen mit einem shared desk System, kostenlosen Getränken und in gut angebundenen Bürogebäuden.
Teamspirit: Bei unseren Mitarbeiterevents und über unser Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm erlebst Du echten Zusammenhalt. Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und Raum für Deine Ideen sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

Wir wachsen - wachse mit uns

Hier kannst du deine Ideen verwirklichen, dich weiterentwickeln und wachsen. Wir haben viel zu bieten. Komm zu uns und gestalte mit uns gemeinsam die Zukunft.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping technical direction and helping teams turn ideas into robust solutions?

As a Senior Solution Architect
, you will help design and evolve cloud-based digital services throughout their lifecycle. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, other architects and Security Architects to translate business and technical needs into secure, scalable and sustainable solutions.

This is a hands-on architecture role. You will stay close to implementation, guide technical decisions and help teams turn architectural direction into working software.

About The Role

Architecture at WirelessCar is a collaborative effort. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will help teams navigate complex technical decisions, create alignment across different perspectives and ensure that solutions work both technically and from a business perspective.

You will work across the bigger system landscape while staying close enough to the implementation to understand the challenges teams face and help them make sound technical decisions.

Your Impact

Design and evolve solution architectures for cloud-based digital services.
Work closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Solution Architects and Security Architects to turn requirements into effective technical solutions.
Guide development teams in architectural decisions and help them evaluate technical alternatives and trade-offs.
Ensure that architecture addresses important quality attributes such as security, scalability, performance, resilience and cost.
Communicate architectural decisions and their implications clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
Stay close to implementation and help teams turn architectural direction into working software.
Contribute to the WirelessCar architecture community by sharing knowledge, developing best practices and learning from other architects.

What We're Looking For

You are a technically experienced and pragmatic architect who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details.

You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You are comfortable explaining why a technical decision makes sense, listening to different perspectives and helping teams reach a good solution.

You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and see architecture as something that is developed together with the teams — not something created separately and handed over for implementation.

We believe you bring:

Experience designing and evolving cloud-native solutions, preferably using AWS and/or Azure.
A strong background in software engineering and modern Agile development practices.
Experience designing distributed systems and working with APIs, integrations and service-oriented architectures.
An understanding of non-functional requirements including security, scalability, availability, resilience, performance and cost.
Programming experience in Java, Python or similar languages, allowing you to engage meaningfully with development teams and implementation decisions.
Experience communicating technical concepts, decisions and trade-offs to different audiences.
Experience working collaboratively across teams and disciplines in complex development environments.

It would be a plus if you have:

Experience with Kubernetes, containerised platforms or similar cloud-native technologies.
Experience with system or data migration initiatives.
Interest in or experience with AI-enabled solutions, such as generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning platforms or applying AI to improve engineering and product capabilities.
Experience with data-driven, event-driven or analytics-oriented architectures.
Experience with observability, DevSecOps, platform engineering or developer experience improvements.
Experience with technical risk assessment and mitigation.
Experience working with globally distributed development teams.
Knowledge of the automotive industry, connected vehicles or large-scale IoT solutions.
Relevant AWS, Azure or other cloud certifications.

Why WirelessCar

At WirelessCar, you’ll have the trust and freedom to take ownership, share ideas and make an impact. We value collaboration, curiosity and different perspectives, and believe people do their best work when they have room to grow.

Freedom to make an impact – Take ownership and help shape what we do.
Collaboration across borders – Work with talented people and perspectives from around the world.
Room to grow – Develop your skills, explore new areas and learn along the way.
Space for ideas – Challenge the way we work and turn ideas into action.
A supportive environment – We care about each other and create space to contribute, grow and do your best work.

At WirelessCar, we want you to enjoy what you do, feel proud of what you contribute and have fun along the way.

What To Expect

Initial screening – A first conversation with Talent Acquisition about your experience and motivation.
Assessment & interview – Depending on the role, you may complete an assessment and meet with the Hiring Manager or relevant team members.
Role-specific interviews – Further conversations to explore your skills and experience in more depth.
Final steps – References and, where required, background checks before moving forward with an offer.
Offer – If we both feel it’s the right match, we’ll discuss the final details and make you an offer.

The exact process may vary depending on the role and location.

Ready to join the ride?

No cover letter needed –
just a few questions to help us better understand your experience, skills and motivation.

Please submit your application in English, our company language.

A valid work permit is required.

Not quite the right role for you? No worries!
Connect with our talent community and follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date with future opportunities.

jobs.description:
Join our small, hands-on team to create AI solutions in enterprise context and launch your own ideas at the same time. You’ll have real freedom, shape the tech, and share in the success (salary, earnings share and equity in products we launch). If you have a startup spirit, enjoy side projects, and want to see your work make a real impact, we'd love to connect.

About us

Overfly is a Berlin-based Partner for Applied AI. We're a team of engineers, product builders and strategists who help enterprises find high-impact AI use cases, then design and build them to production.

Tasks
What you'll be doing

**

Technical leadership**

• Owning the technical direction of client projects end-to-end, from architecture decisions (multi-tenant cloud, auth, data isolation) to production-ready delivery on enterprise cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP, OVH)

• Making and defending the unsexy calls: IaC standards, release strategies, CI/CD pipelines, security architecture, deployment topology

• Designing systems that hold up in regulated enterprise environments, including DSGVO, ISO 27001, SOC2, pen-tests, and compliance reviews

Stakeholder navigation in complex enterprise settings

• Being the technical voice in client meetings. You translate trade-offs, scope feasibility, and shape requirements with non-technical decision makers, IT security, legal, and C-levels in parallel

• Running the room when enterprise stakeholders disagree: mediating between internal IT (firewalls, VPN, network architecture), external partners (hosting, auth providers), and process owners with conflicting agendas

• Managing expectations proactively: surfacing risks early, correcting unrealistic cost or timeline assumptions with real numbers, and escalating through the right channels when needed

• Communicating commitments that hold. Binding dates, clear scope, honest status. Not optimism disguised as a plan

Forward Deployed work

• Embedding into client teams, shipping real features alongside their engineers and process owners, often across multiple organisations at once

• Ramping quickly into unfamiliar codebases, legacy enterprise systems (Oracle, SAP-adjacent environments) and complex domains (utility metering, insurance, FMCG)

• Translating user reality (e.g. the Sachbearbeiterin who wants Excel-like UX) into something your engineering team can actually build

Team organisation

• Coordinating internal engineers, external partners, and client staff on the same delivery: clear ownership, clear handoffs, clear status

• Unblocking problems across projects, reviewing code, and raising the bar on how we ship

• Collaborating with strategy and product to turn business goals into technical plans with budget and timeline attached

Hands-on engineering

• Building full-stack solutions with TypeScript (React, Node, Next.js, Tailwind) and integrating AI where it creates real value, not where it's trendy

• Staying ahead on AI tooling and pulling what works into our projects and workflows

Requirements
What you'll bring

• 5–8+ years of full-stack experience (React, Node, TypeScript) and at least one production deployment you personally owned from architecture to go-live on a major cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP or equivalent)

• Proven ability to own technical direction from start to finish: architecture, infra, CI/CD, security, delivery

• Consulting or agency experience working directly with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated environments (utilities, finance, insurance, pharma)

• Outstanding communication skills in German and English. You can explain a VPN trade-off to a non-technical CFO and a compliance officer in the same meeting, and both leave convinced

• Calm under stakeholder pressure. You know when to push back, when to escalate, and when to just ship

• An entrepreneurial mindset. You turn ambiguity into plans and plans into working products

• German at a professional working level. Non-negotiable for our enterprise client conversations

Tech we use

Our current tools include:

• AI frameworks and APIs (LangChain, OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Azure AI)

• TypeScript (React, Node), Tailwind CSS, Next.JS, Vite, React, React Router

• Analytics tools like Mixpanel and PostHog

• Databases like Supabase, Postgresql, Azure Cosmos DB

• Deployment platforms (Vercel, Google Cloud)

Benefits
What we offer

• Real equity in the products we build together, with an option to invest further

• 4-day work week as team default

• Customizable perks (transportation pass, gym membership, rental bike), choose what fits your life

• Autonomous, self-managed work environment

• Experienced, flat team structure, no corporate hierarchy here

• Opportunity to build practical, valuable AI products used by real people

• Remote or hybrid work model: 2 days/week at Delta Campus, the rest remote

• Competitive salary plus annual bonus based on company performance

How to apply

We don't need a polished CV. Just send us your LinkedIn profile or a quick overview of your background, plus short answers (2–5 sentences each) to these prompts:

• A project you built yourself and what made it special

• Why you're excited about AI, especially something you think most people get wrong

• A full-stack project where you took technical leadership

• A clever non-technical solution or "hack" you've used to gain an advantage

This helps us quickly understand who you are and what motivates you.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer – Vialto Rewards -
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vialto is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work. 

Working at Vialto is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team.  Globally, Vialto has over 8,000 staff and continues to grow.  You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.  

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.

To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry.  You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram. 

Role Summary

Vialto is hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and operate secure, scalable products that power our Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity offerings for the world’s most complex multinational employers. You will deliver hands-on engineering across Next.js and React front ends and C# and .NET services running on Microsoft Azure, working in a highly regulated, multi-jurisdictional environment where accuracy, auditability, and data privacy are non-negotiable. This role is for an experienced engineer who can own end-to-end features—from cross-border compensation data ingestion to shadow payroll calculation engines to equity event processing—contribute to architectural decisions and consistently deliver production-ready solutions using agentic development practices including spec-driven development and agent-driven development with tools such as Claude Code and Codex. You will build AI-native products and workflows, embedding AI capabilities directly into compensation, payroll, and equity workflows to reduce manual effort and improve global mobility outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Build and evolve modern web experiences for Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity products using Next.js, React, and TypeScript with a focus on performance, reliability, and clarity for tax, payroll, and mobility operators.
Design and implement backend services and APIs using C#, .NET, and WebAPI to support compensation data ingestion, cross-border payroll calculations, equity event processing, and integrations with client HR, payroll, and equity administration systems (e.g., Workday, SAP, ADP, Shareworks, E*TRADE, Carta).
Deliver Azure-native implementations of shadow payroll calculation engines, compensation aggregation pipelines, and equity tax event workflows using Microsoft PaaS services, secure patterns, and operational best practices.
Contribute to system architecture and technical design for multi-country payroll, compensation, and equity domains, including integration patterns using REST, file-based feeds, and event-driven approaches.
Own production readiness for your work including logging, monitoring and alerting, reconciliation tooling, incident response support, and operational documentation—critical for payroll cycles and equity event deadlines that cannot slip.
Apply secure development practices appropriate for handling sensitive compensation, payroll, and equity data including privacy, auditability, segregation of duties, and country-specific data protection requirements (GDPR, SOC 2, country-level payroll regulations).
Partner with product, mobility tax, payroll, and equity subject-matter experts to translate complex regulatory and client requirements into technical plans and deliverables.
Use agentic development practices including agent-driven development with Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding agents to accelerate design, implementation, testing, and operations across the SDLC.
Work in a spec-driven development workflow, authoring detailed specifications—including country-specific shadow payroll rules and equity tax treatment—that guide both human and AI agent implementation.
Design and implement AI-powered features within Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity products including intelligent data extraction from compensation statements, anomaly detection on payroll inputs, LLM-assisted user workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over tax and payroll guidance.
Evaluate, integrate, and operationalize AI APIs, models, and toolchains within application architectures, ensuring responsible AI usage, cost management, and observability—especially where AI touches financially material outputs.
Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance on payroll, compensation, and equity domain patterns.

Required Qualifications

5+ years professional software development experience building enterprise web applications and services, ideally including payroll, compensation, equity, HR, finance, or tax domains.
Strong experience designing and building large JavaScript applications with Next.js and/or React (TypeScript, state management, performance optimization).
Strong backend development experience in C# and .NET (ASP.NET, WebAPI, MVC) including API design and service patterns for high-integrity calculation and data-processing systems.
Proven experience with Microsoft Azure designing and building cloud solutions using PaaS services, frameworks, and operational tooling.
Experience delivering systems in regulated or compliance-oriented environments (security controls, auditability, privacy, sensitive financial or personal data handling).
Strong engineering fundamentals including design patterns, separation of concerns, scalable architecture, and pragmatic trade-offs—with attention to accuracy and reconciliation in calculation-heavy systems.
Experience with agentic or AI-assisted development workflows such as spec-driven development, agent-driven development using tools like Claude Code or Codex, or similar AI coding agent practices.
Demonstrated ability to build products that incorporate AI capabilities including prompt design, LLM API integration, or AI-augmented user experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience building or integrating with payroll, shadow payroll, compensation collection, equity administration, or global mobility tax platforms.
Familiarity with cross-border compensation concepts: gross-to-net calculations, hypothetical tax, tax equalization, modified shadow payroll, and equity-related compensation events (RSU vest, ISO/NSO exercise, ESPP).
Experience integrating with HCM, payroll, and equity systems such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Ceridian/Dayforce, Shareworks, E*TRADE, Carta, or country-specific payroll engines.
Azure certifications and/or Microsoft certifications.
Experience with event-based and distributed systems including messaging and asynchronous workflows for payroll cycles and equity event processing.
Data and persistence experience with SQL Server and ORMs (Entity Framework, nHibernate) plus caching strategies; experience modeling compensation, payroll, and equity data is a strong plus.
Strong testing discipline including TDD and BDD, xUnit, Jest or Mocha, CI/CD automation, and quality gates—especially for calculation engines requiring reconciliation and regression coverage.
Experience building analytics and reporting with BI and data visualization tools, including payroll reconciliation, compensation analytics, and equity reporting.
Exposure to mobile ecosystems (iOS and Android) and API design supporting mobile clients for assignee/employee experiences.
Experience with prompt engineering patterns, RAG architectures, vector databases, or AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Services).
Familiarity with AI code generation and review workflows, including evaluating and curating AI-generated code for production readiness in regulated financial workflows.

Technical Skills We Value

Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SPA architecture, performance and accessibility
Backend: C#, ASP.NET, WebAPI, RESTful design, authentication and authorization patterns, high-integrity calculation services
Cloud: Azure PaaS services, observability, secure networking, identity, deployment automation
Domain: Compensation Collection workflows, Shadow Payroll calculation and reporting, Equity event processing and tax treatment, cross-border payroll integrations
Engineering practices: Git-based workflows, secure SDLC, spec-driven development, AI-assisted code reviews, automated testing, reconciliation tooling, documentation
AI-enabled delivery: agentic development using Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding agents; spec-driven development workflows; prompt engineering; LLM API integration; RAG patterns; AI orchestration frameworks; responsible AI practices and observability

What Success Looks Like

Delivers complex Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity features end-to-end with high quality, predictable timelines, and production readiness aligned to payroll cycles and equity event deadlines.
Produces clean, maintainable code—whether hand-written or AI-generated—with strong test coverage, reconciliation checks, and clear documentation.
Identifies and resolves performance, reliability, accuracy, and security issues before they reach production or affect a client’s payroll or equity event.
Contributes meaningfully to architecture and raises standards through code reviews and technical leadership across the compensation, payroll, and equity domains.
Communicates clearly with engineering, product, and domain experts; flags risks early; and collaborates effectively across teams and geographies.
Effectively leverages agentic development tools and AI-augmented workflows to increase velocity while maintaining the quality, accuracy, and security standards required for regulated financial workflows.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field required.
Master’s degree preferred.

Why This Role

You’ll help build and scale the technology behind Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity—the engines that keep globally mobile employees of the world’s largest multinationals paid accurately, taxed correctly, and compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll modernize and operate a platform that sits at the intersection of complex tax regulations, sensitive financial and personal data, and high-stakes global payroll and equity events. You’ll also work at the forefront of AI-augmented engineering, using agentic development practices and building AI-powered product experiences that redefine how global mobility compensation, payroll, and equity technology is delivered.

We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status.

Please note, AI is used as part of the application process.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Join Protein Works as our Senior Backend Developer, and build a greenfield, cloud-native platform from the ground up using Go and modern microservices architecture.

About The Role

The Protein Works is a UK direct-to-consumer sports nutrition brand. We develop and manufacture our own products, sell them through our own e-commerce platform and ship them from our own warehouse. Behind the website sits a set of internal applications connecting orders, stock, finance, fulfilment and manufacturing, alongside a growing number of marketplaces and third-party services.

We are replacing those legacy internal applications with a new cloud-native platform: independently deployable services that will become the single integration layer between the website, finance, warehouse and manufacturing, and a foundation for AI-assisted automation across the business. This role is a core builder of that platform.

You will join a small, polyglot engineering team working DevOps, Information Security, Data and IT. Go is our preferred language for services because of its performance and operational simplicity, but we hire for engineering depth first: if your background is C#, Java or PHP and you are willing to work in Go, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

Platform Development & Architecture: Design, build, and maintain microservices and domain models (orders, stock, fulfilment, finance) using Go, Domain-Driven Design, enterprise integration patterns, and clean architecture to incrementally replace legacy applications.

Integration & Asynchronous Workflows: Build event-driven and queue-based workflows with REST APIs, authentication, idempotency, and contract testing to connect e-commerce, ERP, WMS, finance, and manufacturing systems.

Operations, Security & AI: Own end-to-end delivery including containers, CI/CD, IaC, full observability (metrics, traces, logs), security/privacy compliance (OWASP, GDPR, pen testing), and day-to-day use of AI-assisted/agentic tools.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate across tech and business teams, write ADRs, contribute to golden-path templates/standards, and translate business needs into technical execution.

What you will bring

Essential

Backend & Architecture: 5+ years of backend development (Go, Java, C#, or PHP with a focus/openness to Go) with strong CS/software engineering foundations, SOLID principles, and clean/event-driven patterns across microservices and monoliths.
Data & Async Systems: Solid background in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and asynchronous messaging (queues, events, retries, idempotency).
DevOps & Observability: Practical experience with Docker, Linux/Windows, Git/GitHub, Jira/Agile, monitoring/alerting, and diagnostic/profiling tools in high-volume e-commerce environments.
Communication & AI Integration: Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills, coupled with active practice using AI development/coding tools.

Desirable

AI & Cloud Technologies: Agentic AI (LLMs, frameworks, guardrails) and cloud platforms (AWS, IaC/Terraform, serverless, managed messaging, Kubernetes, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch).
Advanced Engineering & Integrations: Production Go experience, GoF/Enterprise integration patterns, durable workflows, contract testing, ERP/WMS/e-commerce integrations, OpenTelemetry/Grafana/Datadog, and OWASP/ISO 27001 security standards.

How we work

Two-week sprints for planned platform work and a Kanban lane for operational and integration requests, both in Jira. Pull requests with code review, automated tests and CI/CD to staging and production. Architecture Decision Records for anything that changes the shape of the platform, and golden-path templates per language so services stay consistent without forcing one runtime. Observability, security and documentation are part of the definition of done.

State of the art PW Campus
Hybrid working
A greenfield platform to build, a modern toolchain and direct access to the decisions that shape both
Company bonus eligibility
Exclusive staff discounts
Private healthcare
Birthday day off
Pension scheme

Refreshments on-site

Role: Head of Software Engineering
Salary: £90K - £110K + annual performance bonus
Location: Lancaster, 4 days/week preferred, 2 days/week minimum
Relocation: Relocation package available
Reporting into: Chief Technology Officer
Start: ASAP

About Quantum Base

Quantum Base exists to make quantum science useful. Founded at Lancaster University in 2015 by Professor Robert Young, we have spent a decade solving a problem the security industry had accepted as unsolvable: authentication that is impossible to copy, clone or fake, yet simple enough for anyone to use.

Our core technology, Q-ID®, is an authentication fingerprint built on quantum physics that anyone can authenticate in under three seconds with the smartphone already in their pocket. Impossibly simple. Atomically secure.

Q-ID® is protected by more than 40 patents, has undergone independent adversarial testing, and is already protecting around two billion products worldwide across tax stamps, pharmaceuticals, alcohol, luxury goods, FMCG, automotive, aerospace, secure documents and more. We work with printers and brands to make quantum technology practical and accessible for any product, anywhere in the world.

Quantum Base is headquartered in Lancaster and listed on the London Stock Exchange (LON: QUBE) in 2025. See Q-ID® in action: https://www.quantumbase.com/how-q-id-works

About the Role

The Head of Software Engineering will be responsible for leading and managing a multidisciplinary engineering team, with a tech stack spanning (in order of importance):
Machine Learning (neural networks, signal processing, computer vision; Python)
Advanced algorithm development (Python)
Cloud platforms (mainly AWS)
Mobile development (iOS & Android)
Web App (ASP.Net, JavaScript on Azure)
Desktop App (Python)

This senior leadership position requires someone who can be hands on and is still in the code day-to-day. You’ll drive technical excellence, foster innovation, encourage continual improvement and deliver high-quality software solutions. Including:
Strategic Leadership
Drive the simplification and consolidation of our platform, models and algorithms so the business can scale without proportional engineering growth
Define the technical vision and strategy for software development in alignment with business objectives.
Oversee the development and deployment of scalable, high-performing applications and platforms.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the engineering team.
Team Management
Manage, mentor, and inspire a team that includes engineers, machine learning specialists, mathematicians and physicists.
Support talent acquisition, retention, and development to ensure a high-performing team.
Technical Oversight
Provide hands-on technical guidance for complex software development projects, specifically with the application of machine learning and advanced algorithms.
Ensure best practices in software development, including code quality, testing, and documentation.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to define technical requirements and ensure successful delivery.

Key experience

Proven experience (8+ years) in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
Strong quantitative background (physics, mathematics or a closely related discipline)
Expertise across our technology stack.
Strong engineering fundamentals (testing, design, code quality)
Strong understanding of software development methodologies, including Agile and DevOps practices.

30 days annual leave, plus public holidays.
Flexible working hours.
Hybrid working.
Cycle to Work scheme.
Pension.
Annual bonus.
Participation in the company share scheme.

This is a rare chance to lead software engineering at a company where the hardest problems are physics and mathematics, not process. If you want to build on that kind of foundation, we want to hear from you.
