jobs.title: Backend Engineer – Healthcare Integrations & Systems
jobs.description:
Who is FluidAI?

FluidAI Medical is creating a paradigm shift in post-operative care, utilizing the plethora of data within the body, to help in the detection of post-operative complications at their onset. Our clinically validated platform sensing technology augments existing wound drains and catheters, providing healthcare providers with a smart monitoring tool that can support earlier detection of deadly complications and enhance the delivery of care.
We are an equal-opportunity employer and have a diverse team representation across language, ethnicity, gender and nationality.

Why join FluidAI Medical?

Mission to save lives and improve patient care with revolutionary technology that's already deployed on patients in real-world settings.
Work with a high-performing and cross-functional team that is empowered to grow, learn, and contribute across all levels of the organization.
We are a team of passionate builders and boundary-breakers that are on a singular mission to disrupt how patient care is done. We aim to succeed and perform together - as a team and as individuals.
Gain exposure across the entire technical stack, from novel sensing technologies and proprietary hardware to mobile/web software and ML algorithms.
Personal career-focused development and training with access to workshops, coursework, and experienced mentors/consultants.

Backend Engineer – Healthcare Integrations & Systems

FluidAI Medical is at the forefront of integrating data, technology, and healthcare to improve patient outcomes. Our platform generates rich, high-frequency clinical data at the bedside, and for that data to change how care is delivered it must flow reliably into the systems clinicians already use. We are expanding our team to include a Backend Engineer who can design and build the integration layer that connects our platform to hospital EHRs, laboratory and device systems, and national health data exchanges.
This role is ideal for a hands-on backend engineer with strong experience building production APIs and services, deep familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 FHIR and HL7 v2, and a track record of shipping and supporting integrations in live hospital environments. Experience with EHR vendor integration (e.g., Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, InterSystems) and regional health information exchange requirements is highly preferred.
This position is remote but requires travel across the Middle East to collaborate with the FluidAI team, hospital IT departments, and clients.

Responsibilities

🔌 Design, build, and maintain the integration services that exchange clinical data between the FluidAI platform and hospital systems (EHRs, LIS, ADT feeds, device gateways, and national health exchanges).
🧬 Implement and maintain HL7 FHIR APIs and resources (e.g., Patient, Encounter, Observation, Device, DiagnosticReport) as well as HL7 v2 message interfaces (ADT, ORU, ORM) for inbound and outbound data flows.
🏗️ Build clean, well-tested, production-grade backend services and APIs (REST and event-driven) that are secure, observable, and resilient to the realities of hospital networks.
🗺️ Own data mapping and transformation logic between FluidAI's internal data models and external standards, including terminology mapping (LOINC, SNOMED CT, UCUM) and vendor-specific profile variations.
🔁 Develop robust interface engine and integration patterns: message queuing, retries, deduplication, acknowledgement handling, idempotency, and reconciliation.
🏥 Lead the technical side of hospital onboarding: gather interface requirements, conduct connectivity and message testing with hospital IT and EHR analysts, and support go-live and hypercare.
🔍 Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging for integration health so that message failures and data gaps are caught early and traced end-to-end.
🔐 Apply healthcare security and privacy best practices, including OAuth2/SMART on FHIR, mutual TLS, VPN connectivity, audit logging, and data minimization, in line with regional regulations (e.g., Saudi NPHIES/SeHE requirements, HIPAA, PIPEDA).
📚 Create and maintain clear technical documentation: interface specifications, FHIR implementation guides, integration runbooks, and data flow diagrams.
🤝 Partner with product, clinical, regulatory, and QA teams to ensure integrations meet clinical workflow needs and medical device software standards (e.g., IEC 62304, ISO 13485 processes).
🏃‍♂️ Participate in sprint planning and Agile ceremonies, contributing to roadmap planning and prioritization from an integrations and platform perspective.
🔧 Collaborate closely with software, hardware, data, and ML teams to expose reliable data services across the full technology stack.

Qualifications

📚 Strong hands-on experience as a Backend Engineer, Integration Engineer, or Interoperability Engineer, ideally within healthcare or medical technology.
🧬 Deep working knowledge of HL7 FHIR (R4 and/or R5), including resource modelling, profiles, extensions, search, and bulk data, and hands-on experience with FHIR servers or SDKs (e.g., HAPI FHIR, Firely, Microsoft/Azure FHIR, Google Cloud Healthcare API).
📨 Solid experience with HL7 v2.x messaging, including message structure, segments, ACK/NACK handling, and common workflows (ADT, ORU, ORM, MDM).
🔌 Experience with integration/interface engines such as Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect), Rhapsody, InterSystems, Cloverleaf, or equivalent custom pipelines.
💻 High proficiency in at least one backend language such as Python, Java/Kotlin, C#/.NET, Go, or TypeScript/Node.js, with strong API design skills (REST, OpenAPI, webhooks) and familiarity with message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT).
🗄️ Strong SQL and data modelling skills with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and familiarity with NoSQL or time-series stores.
☁️ Experience deploying and operating services in cloud and hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; CI/CD; infrastructure as code), including on-premise hospital deployments.
🔐 Working knowledge of healthcare security and identity standards: OAuth2/OIDC, SMART on FHIR, TLS/mTLS, encryption at rest and in transit, and audit requirements.
🏥 Direct experience integrating with EHR vendors (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, MEDITECH, InterSystems TrakCare, or regional systems) and working alongside hospital IT teams is highly preferred.
🧠 Familiarity with clinical terminologies (LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, UCUM) and with medical device connectivity standards (e.g., IEEE 11073, IHE profiles such as PIX/PDQ, XDS) is a strong plus.
📋 Familiarity with regulated software development practices (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, risk management, traceability) is a plus.
🗣️ Fluent in English; Arabic is a strong plus. Ability to communicate clearly with both engineers and hospital IT and clinical stakeholders.
✈️ Must be able and willing to travel within Saudi Arabia for work, including extended periods of time.
🤝 Comfortable working in cross-functional, fast-paced, and collaborative environments.
💡 Strong problem-solving mindset with a bias toward impact, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Application Process

📞 Introductory phone call (~15 minutes).
📝 Technical & systems design working session (~1 hour).
🎤 Final interview (~45 minutes).
📜 Offer stage.

If you are passionate about making clinical data flow seamlessly between systems and want to build the integration foundations that put real-time patient insights directly into clinicians' hands, we would love to hear from you.

Job Description: Quantitative Developer, Systematic Equities

Please direct all resume submissions to QuantTalentEUR@mlp.com and reference REQ-26457 in the subject.

Millennium is a top tier global hedge fund with a strong commitment to leveraging market innovations in technology and data to deliver high-quality returns.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and entrepreneurial Lead Software Engineer to architect, build, and scale the core trading infrastructure for a newly formed quantitative trading pod. You will lead the design and deployment of systems that support systematic strategies operating across global markets and time zones.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of technology, research, and trading - you'll collaborate directly with quantitative researchers and the Senior Portfolio Manager to turn ideas into production-ready strategies.

The pod is led by a Senior Portfolio Manager with 15+ years of experience and a proven track record in alpha generation, strategy development, and risk management at top-tier quant firms. This is a unique opportunity to own the technology stack from day one, influence strategic direction, and help shape a high-performance team in a collaborative and intellectually rigorous environment.

Location

Dubai

Principal Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture
Design and maintain the trading system architecture, including components for data ingestion, signal generation, backtesting, execution, and risk management
Make decisions on technology stack, performance optimization, and scalability
Ensure the system supports reasonable latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant trading

Team Leadership & Collaboration
Help recruit and Lead a small team of developers (sometimes quants as well) within the pod
Work closely with the quant researchers and traders to understand strategy requirements and translate them into code
Prioritize tasks and mentor junior developers or quant devs

Strategy Implementation Support
Build and maintain research infrastructure (e.g., backtesting frameworks, simulation environments, feature stores)
Translate researchers' prototypes (e.g., in Python) into production­ grade code, often in C++, or C# for latency-sensitive components

Execution & Infrastructure
Optimize and support order execution systems, integrating with various exchanges or broker APIs
Implement real-time risk checks, monitoring, logging, and alerting tools

Data Engineering & Management
Oversee the pipeline for ingesting, cleaning, and storing data (market, alternative, internal)
Ensure data integrity and low-latency access for trading and research

DevOps & Reliability
Often take responsibility for deployment pipelines, version control, and production support
Ensure high system availability and rapid recovery in case of failures

Security & Compliance
Make sure that the pod's infrastructure adheres to firm-wide compliance and security standards
Ensure rigorous version control, code quality, and documentation standards
Conduct thorough testing and debugging of software components, resolving any issues or discrepancies.

Required Technical Skills

1st class Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
Fluency in C++ or C# for performance-critical systems
Proficiency in Python, especially for scripting, research integration, and data tools
Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and multithreaded/concurrent programming
Strong knowledge of SQL and modern database design (e.g., column stores, time-series DBs)
Familiarity with software engineering best practices: version control (Git), unit testing, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, etc.
Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed systems

Required Experience

3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining high-performance trading systems, ideally in a systematic equities or quant trading environment
Proven experience in:
Handling large-scale market data (e.g., normalization, feed handling, replay systems)
Order routing and exchange connectivity, including FIX protocols and direct market access (DMA)
Building event-driven architectures and real-time systems with tight SLAs
Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system instability in production environments

Highly Valued Relevant Attributes

Excellent communication skills - able to interface directly with quant researchers and traders, translate requirements, and explain technical decisions
Demonstrated initiative and ownership: able to drive projects independently, while collaborating effectively in a team setting
Comfortable in fast-paced, iterative environments where priorities can shift quickly based on market conditions or research insights

new_jobs.title: Full-stack developer GLASS
new_jobs.description:
Wil je deel uitmaken van een Agile productteam dat complexe uitdagingen in het onderwijs aanpakt? Als full-stack developer bij ICT Services van de Universiteit van Amsterdam en Hogeschool van Amsterdam, werk je samen met jouw collega's aan innovatieve oplossingen voor studieplanning, waardoor studenten hun academische traject effectiever kunnen beheren.

Werken bij de UvA

Kom bij ons werken

Als full-stack developer ben je binnen het productteam GLASS verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van het nieuwe product STUDIEPLAN. Er wordt gebruik gemaakt van .NET in de back-end en React + TypeScript in de front-end, waarbij de communicatie tussen de twee op basis van GraphQL plaatsvindt. Er wordt gebruik gemaakt van de Apollo Client in een omgeving die is gebouwd volgens het CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) patroon. Als team zijn we verantwoordelijk voor het volledig functioneren van onze oplossingen, en we hanteren het principe 'you build it, you run it'. Ook ben je betrokken bij het ontwerpen en opzetten van geautomatiseerde tests met rapportages.

Een goed salaris Je salaris wordt bepaald op basis van jouw ervaring en senioriteit, conform de CAO Universiteiten. Je inschaling en dus de genoemde bedragen zijn gebaseerd op een volledig dienstverband van 38 uur per week.
232 vakantie-uren Ook bieden we ouderschapsverlof, partnerverlof en verlof wegens maatschappelijke betrokkenheid. Via de Menukaart Arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn er mogelijkheden tot nog meer vakantie-uren.
Financiële regelingen Bovenop je salaris ontvang je vakantiegeld (8%) en een eindejaarsuitkering (8,3%). Je bouwt een goed pensioen op bij het ABP. En daarnaast bieden we nog veel meer tegemoetkomingen en regelingen.
Loopbaanontwikkeling en ruimte voor groei De UvA stimuleert jou om je blijvend te professionaliseren d.m.v. trainingen en open UvA-colleges.
Flexibiliteit Je hebt de flexibiliteit om werk en privé te combineren, vaak met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken.

Alles over deze vacature

Dit ga je doen

Denk hierbij aan de volgende werkzaamheden:

De ontwikkeling van het nieuwe STUDIEPLAN-product binnen het GLASS-productteam;
Uitwerken van functionele eisen en technische oplossingen, programmeren van nieuwe systeemdelen, testen, analyseren van testresultaten en foutcorrectie;
Ontwerpen en implementeren van geautomatiseerde tests met bijbehorende rapportages.

Dit vragen we van jou

Wij zoeken een ervaren professional die:

Back-end vereisten:

Ervaring in C# en de nieuwste versies van .NET (minimaal 5 jaar);
Ervaring met verschillende ontwikkeltools, zoals Docker en Git;
Ervaring met Azure, IaC, Kubernetes, Terraform en GitOps;
Ervaring met micro services;
Ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen van schaalbare API’s; specifieke ervaring met GraphQL is een sterke pre.

Front-end vereisten:

Ervaring met front-end frameworks; specifieke ervaring met React is een pre;
Ervaring met TypeScript;
Kennis van gebruik van GraphQL API’s met de Apollo client;
Je schrijft graag zelf CSS;
Kennis van module federation voor micro frontends is een pre.

Algemeen profiel:

Bekendheid met agile ontwikkelingsmethodieken;
Professionele beheersing van de Nederlandse taal maar je hoeft geen native speaker te zijn;
Passie voor het vinden van technische oplossingen en het leveren van kwaliteit;
Zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid in het beheer van applicaties en releases;
Ervaring met het opzetten van complexe web applicaties.

Dit bieden we jou nog meer

Een dynamische en creatieve werkomgeving waar je veel ruimte krijgt voor individuele inbreng en waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd!

Deze functie past binnen het functieprofiel IT-IV Engineering and Application Manager 1 of 2. Bij deze functie hoort schaal 11 of 12. Het salaris bedraagt minimaal €4.925,- en maximaal €7.573,- bruto per maand bij een volledig dienstverband (38 uur per week) exclusief vakantiegeld (8%) en eindejaarsuitkering (8,3%) en is afhankelijk van competenties en ervaring. De cao Nederlandse Universiteiten is van toepassing.

De UvA heeft een uitgebreid pakket secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:

29 vakantiedagen bij een volledig dienstverband & extra vakantiedagen tussen kerst en de jaarwisseling;
Mobiele telefoon en een laptop;
Internet- en thuiswerkvergoeding;
Pensioenopbouw bij het ABP;
Je hebt de flexibiliteit om werk en privé te combineren, met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken;
Door wekelijks twee uur meer te werken dan je contracturen, ontvang je op jaarbasis 96 compensatie-uren. Dat geldt ook als je parttimer bent;
Daarnaast biedt de UvA uitstekende studie- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en stimuleert medewerkers om zich blijvend te professionaliseren;
Ook kun je deelnemen aan Open UvA-Colleges om je verder te ontwikkelen en je horizon te verbreden. De UvA vergoedt de kosten hiervoor binnen de daarvoor geldende regeling.

Het betreft een fulltime dienstverband voor 38 uur per week. We bieden een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst voor een jaar met uitzicht op een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd. Je standplaats wordt Hogehilweg 21, Amsterdam.

Nieuwsgierig naar onze organisatie en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een ruime vakantieregeling en ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Hier lees je meer over werken bij de Universiteit van Amsterdam. Voor de HvA, zie medewerkers aan het woord.

Jouw plek bij de UvA

In dit team / bij deze afdeling kom je te werken

De Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA) leveren kwalitatief hoogwaardig onderwijs en onderzoek. Zonder ICT zijn de 90.000 studenten en 10.000 medewerkers van de HvA en UvA nergens. Niet voor niets werken er ruim 300 professionals bij de centrale dienst ICT Services (ICTS). Van het leveren van ICT-middelen tot het onderhouden van de technische infrastructuur, en van het ontwikkelen van apps tot gebruikersondersteuning via de servicedesk: ons takenpakket is superbreed. Je kunt dus alle kanten op.

We werken aan complexe technische uitdagingen zoals cloud computing, big data en machine learning. En als het gaat om cybersecurity, dan loopt onze ICT-organisatie landelijk voorop. Wat jouw werk nog meer zo boeiend maakt, is dat je bijdraagt aan onderwijs en onderzoek. Daarin werken we aan de beste combinatie tussen innoveren en kwaliteit. Kortom, je blijft up-to-date en hebt een baan met maatschappelijke impact. Meer lezen

Afdeling Applicatiebeheer, Team GLASS

Welkom bij het GLASS team, waar innovatie en samenwerking samenkomen. In team GLASS krijg je de kans om een significante impact te hebben op de toekomst van onderwijsvoorbereiding en technologische vooruitgang. Ons team is vastberaden om de volgende doelstellingen te verwezenlijken:

Onze uitdaging is het bouwen van het nieuwe en complexe STUDIEPLAN en het tegelijkertijd verbeteren en uitbreiden van de huidige functionaliteit van de GLASS-applicatie;
Studenten ondersteunen bij succesvolle studieplanning en vakaanmelding. Een zorgeloze ervaring van begin tot eind van de studie;
Faculteiten faciliteren op gebied van onderwijsvoorbereiding en ondersteuning bij de uitvoering van het onderwijs;
Wij zijn toegewijd aan het verbeteren van onze ontwikkelprocessen door de implementatie van Continuous Integration en Continuous Delivery. Dit stelt ons in staat om onze softwareontwikkeling sneller en met hogere kwaliteit uit te voeren, wat bijdraagt aan een efficiënte werkomgeving;
Innovatie is een kernwaarde voor ons. We innoveren voortdurend om ervoor te zorgen dat studenten kunnen studeren met behulp van geavanceerde technologieën en processen.

Binnen ons hechte GLASS-team vind je een groep van gedreven professionals. Je werkt zij aan zij met 3 back-end developers, 2 front-end developers, 1 functioneel beheerder, 2 UX/UI Designers, en een product owner. Het team werkt 2 dagen (dinsdagen en donderdagen) op kantoor in Amsterdam-Zuidoost en 3 dagen vanuit huis. We koesteren open communicatie en bevorderen constructieve discussies, omdat we geloven dat dit de basis vormt voor groei en succes. Word lid van ons team en speel een cruciale rol in het vormgeven van de toekomst van onderwijslogistiek en technologische innovatie. Jouw bijdrage zal een blijvende impact hebben op studenten terwijl je samen met ons bouwt aan een betere onderwijservaring.

Voor meer informatie zie onze LinkedIn-pagina Universiteit van Amsterdam: Werken in de ICT en de websites www.hva.nl en www.uva.nl.

Past deze vacature niet bij jouw profiel? We hebben nog meer vacatures!

Kijk hiervoor bij de vacatures van ICTS bij de HvA  en de UvA .

Bij de werving en selectie ter invulling van deze vacature houden wij de UvA Sollicitatiecode aan.

Bij ICTS hechten we veel waarde aan integriteit en kwalificaties. Als onderdeel van ons sollicitatieproces voeren wij een controle uit om de betrouwbaarheid en geschiktheid van onze kandidaten te waarborgen door een identiteitscontrole en diploma- en referentiechecks.

Meer over de UvA

De Universiteit van Amsterdam is ambitieus, creatief en betrokken. Sinds 1632 een inspiratie voor studenten, een voorhoedespeler in de internationale wetenschap en een partner in vernieuwing.

De Universiteit van Amsterdam is de grootste universiteit van Nederland, met het breedste opleidingsaanbod. Een intellectueel knooppunt met 44.000 studenten, 6.000 medewerkers en 3.000 promovendi. Verbonden door een cultuur van nieuwsgierigheid.

Belangrijk om te weten

Jouw sollicitatie & contact

Is dit de baan voor jou en word jij onze nieuwe collega? Wij zijn benieuwd naar jou!

new_jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping technical direction and helping teams turn ideas into robust solutions?

As a Senior Solution Architect
, you will help design and evolve cloud-based digital services throughout their lifecycle. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, other architects and Security Architects to translate business and technical needs into secure, scalable and sustainable solutions.

This is a hands-on architecture role. You will stay close to implementation, guide technical decisions and help teams turn architectural direction into working software.

About The Role

Architecture at WirelessCar is a collaborative effort. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will help teams navigate complex technical decisions, create alignment across different perspectives and ensure that solutions work both technically and from a business perspective.

You will work across the bigger system landscape while staying close enough to the implementation to understand the challenges teams face and help them make sound technical decisions.

Your Impact

Design and evolve solution architectures for cloud-based digital services.
Work closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Solution Architects and Security Architects to turn requirements into effective technical solutions.
Guide development teams in architectural decisions and help them evaluate technical alternatives and trade-offs.
Ensure that architecture addresses important quality attributes such as security, scalability, performance, resilience and cost.
Communicate architectural decisions and their implications clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
Stay close to implementation and help teams turn architectural direction into working software.
Contribute to the WirelessCar architecture community by sharing knowledge, developing best practices and learning from other architects.

What We're Looking For

You are a technically experienced and pragmatic architect who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details.

You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You are comfortable explaining why a technical decision makes sense, listening to different perspectives and helping teams reach a good solution.

You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and see architecture as something that is developed together with the teams — not something created separately and handed over for implementation.

We believe you bring:

Experience designing and evolving cloud-native solutions, preferably using AWS and/or Azure.
A strong background in software engineering and modern Agile development practices.
Experience designing distributed systems and working with APIs, integrations and service-oriented architectures.
An understanding of non-functional requirements including security, scalability, availability, resilience, performance and cost.
Programming experience in Java, Python or similar languages, allowing you to engage meaningfully with development teams and implementation decisions.
Experience communicating technical concepts, decisions and trade-offs to different audiences.
Experience working collaboratively across teams and disciplines in complex development environments.

It would be a plus if you have:

Experience with Kubernetes, containerised platforms or similar cloud-native technologies.
Experience with system or data migration initiatives.
Interest in or experience with AI-enabled solutions, such as generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning platforms or applying AI to improve engineering and product capabilities.
Experience with data-driven, event-driven or analytics-oriented architectures.
Experience with observability, DevSecOps, platform engineering or developer experience improvements.
Experience with technical risk assessment and mitigation.
Experience working with globally distributed development teams.
Knowledge of the automotive industry, connected vehicles or large-scale IoT solutions.
Relevant AWS, Azure or other cloud certifications.

Why WirelessCar

At WirelessCar, you’ll have the trust and freedom to take ownership, share ideas and make an impact. We value collaboration, curiosity and different perspectives, and believe people do their best work when they have room to grow.

Freedom to make an impact – Take ownership and help shape what we do.
Collaboration across borders – Work with talented people and perspectives from around the world.
Room to grow – Develop your skills, explore new areas and learn along the way.
Space for ideas – Challenge the way we work and turn ideas into action.
A supportive environment – We care about each other and create space to contribute, grow and do your best work.

At WirelessCar, we want you to enjoy what you do, feel proud of what you contribute and have fun along the way.

What To Expect

Initial screening – A first conversation with Talent Acquisition about your experience and motivation.
Assessment & interview – Depending on the role, you may complete an assessment and meet with the Hiring Manager or relevant team members.
Role-specific interviews – Further conversations to explore your skills and experience in more depth.
Final steps – References and, where required, background checks before moving forward with an offer.
Offer – If we both feel it’s the right match, we’ll discuss the final details and make you an offer.

The exact process may vary depending on the role and location.

Ready to join the ride?

No cover letter needed –
just a few questions to help us better understand your experience, skills and motivation.

Please submit your application in English, our company language.

A valid work permit is required.

Not quite the right role for you? No worries!
Connect with our talent community and follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date with future opportunities.

Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack Applications – Ratings Technology

to join our global Ratings Technology team in Toronto. This is your opportunity to not just build mission-critical applications, but to shape the future direction

new_jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
new_jobs.description:
Join Protein Works as our Senior Backend Developer, and build a greenfield, cloud-native platform from the ground up using Go and modern microservices architecture.

About The Role

The Protein Works is a UK direct-to-consumer sports nutrition brand. We develop and manufacture our own products, sell them through our own e-commerce platform and ship them from our own warehouse. Behind the website sits a set of internal applications connecting orders, stock, finance, fulfilment and manufacturing, alongside a growing number of marketplaces and third-party services.

We are replacing those legacy internal applications with a new cloud-native platform: independently deployable services that will become the single integration layer between the website, finance, warehouse and manufacturing, and a foundation for AI-assisted automation across the business. This role is a core builder of that platform.

You will join a small, polyglot engineering team working DevOps, Information Security, Data and IT. Go is our preferred language for services because of its performance and operational simplicity, but we hire for engineering depth first: if your background is C#, Java or PHP and you are willing to work in Go, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

Platform Development & Architecture: Design, build, and maintain microservices and domain models (orders, stock, fulfilment, finance) using Go, Domain-Driven Design, enterprise integration patterns, and clean architecture to incrementally replace legacy applications.

Integration & Asynchronous Workflows: Build event-driven and queue-based workflows with REST APIs, authentication, idempotency, and contract testing to connect e-commerce, ERP, WMS, finance, and manufacturing systems.

Operations, Security & AI: Own end-to-end delivery including containers, CI/CD, IaC, full observability (metrics, traces, logs), security/privacy compliance (OWASP, GDPR, pen testing), and day-to-day use of AI-assisted/agentic tools.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate across tech and business teams, write ADRs, contribute to golden-path templates/standards, and translate business needs into technical execution.

What you will bring

Essential

Backend & Architecture: 5+ years of backend development (Go, Java, C#, or PHP with a focus/openness to Go) with strong CS/software engineering foundations, SOLID principles, and clean/event-driven patterns across microservices and monoliths.
Data & Async Systems: Solid background in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and asynchronous messaging (queues, events, retries, idempotency).
DevOps & Observability: Practical experience with Docker, Linux/Windows, Git/GitHub, Jira/Agile, monitoring/alerting, and diagnostic/profiling tools in high-volume e-commerce environments.
Communication & AI Integration: Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills, coupled with active practice using AI development/coding tools.

Desirable

AI & Cloud Technologies: Agentic AI (LLMs, frameworks, guardrails) and cloud platforms (AWS, IaC/Terraform, serverless, managed messaging, Kubernetes, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch).
Advanced Engineering & Integrations: Production Go experience, GoF/Enterprise integration patterns, durable workflows, contract testing, ERP/WMS/e-commerce integrations, OpenTelemetry/Grafana/Datadog, and OWASP/ISO 27001 security standards.

How we work

Two-week sprints for planned platform work and a Kanban lane for operational and integration requests, both in Jira. Pull requests with code review, automated tests and CI/CD to staging and production. Architecture Decision Records for anything that changes the shape of the platform, and golden-path templates per language so services stay consistent without forcing one runtime. Observability, security and documentation are part of the definition of done.

State of the art PW Campus
Hybrid working
A greenfield platform to build, a modern toolchain and direct access to the decisions that shape both
Company bonus eligibility
Exclusive staff discounts
Private healthcare
Birthday day off
Pension scheme

Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 100 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Language Products Track
. This is the heart of DeepL. You will be building and expanding our flagship translation products, the core engines that power everything from our consumer web translator to our Enterprise Customization Hub (Glossaries, Translation Memory, and Style Rules) and complex multimedia localization flows.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers just to implement UI tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire product-obsessed
people who care deeply about the user experience and the business impact of their code . You will build the interfaces and backend systems that allow a global enterprise to maintain their brand voice across 100+ languages effortlessly, while keeping the experience simple enough for a casual user.

Your Responsibilities

Own the Core Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our primary translation products . Whether you are building the UI for the translation flow, engineering the backend logic to parse and translate complex document formats (PDF, Word, PowerPoint) without losing formatting, or integrating DeepL directly into enterprise workflows, you own the outcome.
Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You will solve a unique product challenge: building an interface that feels instant and magical for a B2C user, but is powerful enough to handle the complex, multi-party collaboration and localization workflows required by enterprise teams.
Architect for Ambiguity: You will make high-stakes technical decisions regarding state management, API integrations, and performance. You don't wait for perfect requirements; you prototype, measure user friction, and iterate fast .
Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You will collaborate closely with Research, Product, and Design teams to translate complex AI constraints into an intuitive UX . You will help win market trust by building transparency and performance metrics directly into the product.

Qualities we look for

A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about who uses your software. You ask "Why are we building this?" before writing a line of code. You measure success by user adoption and reduced friction, not just pull requests merged.
Front-end Heavy Full-Stack Fluency: You are a strong Front End engineer who is comfortable traversing the stack to deliver a feature. You can build a highly interactive, performant UI in React and design the supporting backend logic in Python and C#/.NET Core, with the support of agentic tooling.
High Agency & Bias for Action: You don't wait for permission. If you see a performance bottleneck in the translation flow, you profile it. If the documentation for a new API is missing, you write it . You are comfortable unblocking yourself and your team.
A "System Thinker" for UI/UX: You understand that a simple UI often hides massive backend complexity. You can design systems that handle large document states, manage complex terminology rules (Glossaries), and maintain high performance in the browser.

What We Offer

Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

new_jobs.title: QA Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Unily

With 20+ years of expertise, Unily unites people, technology, and knowledge into action through the only AI-native employee experience platform. As the intelligent digital front door to work, Unily helps enterprises from 1,000 to 100,000+ employees, including Estée Lauder Companies, CVS Health, and British Airways, remove friction, increase clarity, and accelerate productivity so work moves faster.

Unily is a five‑time Leader in Employee Experience, recognized as a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Intranet Packaged Solutions, the 2024 Forrester Wave™: Intranet Platforms, and the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Experience‑Centric Intelligent Digital Workspaces 2025. This analyst leadership is reinforced by strong customer validation, including G2 Crowd Leader recognition for exceptional usability and enterprise‑grade performance. Unily also holds the prestigious ClearBox “Intranet Choices 2025” award. With these accolades, we continue to grow and expand our employee community with people who are passionate about joining us on this exciting journey.

Job Purpose

The primary purpose of the Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer role is to ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable, and user-friendly software. This role is critical in identifying and addressing software defects through the design and execution of robust testing. Through collaboration with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, the QA Engineer will produce clear testing objectives and comprehensive test plans, with the goal being to prevent significant bugs or usability issues, thereby safeguarding the user experience and the Unily’s reputation.

This is a hybrid role with an expectation of 1 to 2 days per week in Eashing, Surrey

and occasional days at our London office. You may be expected to be available on call during holiday periods – always by prior arrangement.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with product and development teams during the design phase to identify potential issues early in the process.
Participate in refinement sessions to provide input on testability and potential edge cases.
Design and create comprehensive test cases to ensure all functionalities are examined with appropriate thoroughness.
Execute manual test cases to identify any discrepancies or issues in the software.
Analyse test results carefully to determine the root causes of any detected problems.
Validate and report bugs, providing detailed descriptions and steps to reproduce them.
Design and execute detailed test plans to cover all aspects of the software's functionality.
Design and execute automated tests to streamline the testing process and improve efficiency.
Maintain and update automated tests regularly to ensure they remain effective and relevant.
Provide support to other areas of the business through issue triage and root cause analysis, answering questions and interacting with customers and prospects where required.
Maintain awareness of QA processes and best practices to continuously improve testing methodologies.
Assist in ensuring quality standards are met by collaborating with the development team and providing feedback.

Requirements

Testing experience with web applications
A broad experience in a range of testing types and techniques
Professional test automation experience
Knowledge of Playwright ideally using C#
Knowledge of GIT
Experience using a cloud-based test device platform such as Sauce Labs/Browserstack
API Testing experience (manual or automated) including use of tools such as Postman
Awareness of industry standards and latest developments with test automation tools and practices
ISEB/ISTQB Foundation Level Certification
Knowledge of VSTS or Azure DevOps or equivalent
Experience with an Agile environment where Development teams practice Continuous Delivery
Experience with mobile automation (Appium)
Experience with non-functional testing
Experience of Azure or similar cloud services
Excellent spoken and written communication skills
Capable of working both independently and as part of a team
Passion for quality with high standards for personal and collective achievement

We are united by a shared purpose and are committed to truly understanding each other. We know that everyone is unique and has their own story. We strive to have a diverse workforce that embraces and celebrates one another. We are united in building connections and curious to learn from each other so that we continue to grow together to build the workplace of tomorrow.

Why Work For Unily?

In addition to a generous base salary and discretionary company bonus, here are some things we think you will love:

Our awesome team culture.

We are focused on achieving results as a team and having fun while we do it. You won’t find a friendlier or more dedicated bunch of people.

Our industry leading product.

We are very proud of our ever-evolving product, naturally we use (and love) it internally and provide the tools and resources for you (and our clients) to become a Unily expert.

The flexibility that we offer.

We don’t just mean working from home occasionally. We operate on a hybrid basis, and also recognize that life happens during the 9-5.30 and encourage a sustainable work/life balance.

Our bright and modern office spaces.

When you need to be in the office we want it to be like being at home. We have a well-stocked kitchen and the option to bring your dog to work.

We offer a fantastic suite of benefits.

Including 25 days holiday plus an extra paid day off to enjoy your birthday, Vitality life cover (for health, sight, hearing and dental), Aviva pension (via a salary sacrifice scheme), life assurance, income protection and so many more.

Our commitment to sustainability and giving back to the community.

We know working for an organisation that takes its environmental & social impact seriously is important, and we are proud to offer 1 fully paid volunteering day per year, an employee matching charity donation scheme and options to lease an Electric Vehicle through our salary sacrifice scheme.

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

new_jobs.title: Data Architect
new_jobs.description:
Methods Analytics (MA) is recruiting for a Data Architect to join our team a permanent basis.

This role will be mainly remote but require flexibility to travel to client sites, and our offices based in London, Sheffield, and Bristol.

What You'll Be Doing as a Data Architect:

Advocate the business benefit of data standards, championing and governing those standards across projects and the organisation
Demonstrate an overall perspective on business issues and activities, determining patterns, standards, policies, roadmaps and vision statements
Make and guide effective decisions, explaining clearly how decisions have been reached and resolving technical disputes across varying levels of complexity and risk
Communicate effectively across organisational, technical and political boundaries, making complex technical information accessible for non-technical audiences
Design how to expose data from systems (APIs, real-time streams), link data from multiple systems, and deliver modern data services
Ensure that risks associated with deployment are adequately understood and documented
Design end-to-end data solutions from requirements through implementation, including technical documentation and architecture blueprints
Lead complex data migration projects from legacy systems to modern cloud-native platforms
Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies across the modern data stack to meet specific client needs
Mentor junior team members and collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders

Your Impact:

Enable transformative business decisions through robust, scalable data architectures
Drive adoption of modern data platforms and AI-enabled analytics solutions
Establish technical standards and architectural patterns that ensure quality, security, and maintainability
Help cultivate a data-driven culture within client organisations and internally
Deliver architectures that seamlessly integrate traditional and modern data systems

Requirements

You Will Demonstrate:

Deep knowledge of the Azure data stack (Azure SQL Server, CosmosDB, Azure Data Factory, Purview, Synapse, Event Hub, Azure Databricks/Fabric)
Extensive data modelling experience: both normalised relational models and de-normalised Star Schema/dimensional models
Excellent relational database design skills with expertise in diagnosing and optimising performance across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud databases
Proven track record with complex data migration projects (terabyte+ datasets, multiple legacy source systems, structures and unstructured data)
Proficiency with Parquet/Delta Lake or other modern data storage formats
Experience with streaming architectures using Kafka, Event Hubs, or Kinesis for real-time data processing
Knowledge of data architectures supporting AI/ML workloads, including vector databases, feature stores and MLOps pipelines
Experience processing and managing unstructured data types (text, images, logs, sensor data)
Understanding of Lambda and Kappa architectural patterns and when to apply each

You May Also Have:

Exposure to high-performing, low latency or large volume data systems
Knowledge of and/or experience with Government Digital Service practices across Discovery/Alpha/Beta/Live phases
Understanding of vector databases and similarity search for AI applications
Experience with Infrastructure as Code and modern DevOps practices
Knowledge of how to design and analyse operational logs for data processing, and triage incidents
Awareness of advances in AI technologies, data services, and architectural practices
Industry specialisation in specific sectors (Engineering, Manufacturing, Healthcare etc.)
Public sector or defence experience
Experience with modern unified data platforms like Databricks or Microsoft Fabric
Understanding of data mesh or data fabric architectural approaches
Relevant industry certifications such as TOGAF 9, CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional), or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

Security Clearance:

UKSV (United Kingdom Security Vetting) clearance is required for this role, with Security Check (SC) as the minimum standard, either already held or with a willingness to undergo the process. Some roles/projects may require Developed Vetting (DV) clearance; while not mandatory, a willingness to obtain DV clearance would be beneficial. As part of the onboarding process candidates will be asked to complete a Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS); details of the evidence required to apply may be found on the government website GOV.UK - Government baseline personnel security standard. If you are unable to meet this and any associated criteria, then your employment may be delayed, or rejected. Details of this will be discussed with you at interview.

Our Hiring Process

At Methods Analytics, we believe in a transparent hiring process. Here's what you can expect:

Internal Application Review
Initial Phone Screen
Technical Interview
Collaborative Technical Exercise
Final Interview
Offer

Benefits

Working at MA

Methods Analytics (MA) exists to improve society by helping people make better decisions with data. Combining passionate people, sector-specific insight, and technical excellence to provide our customers an end-to-end data service.

We use a collaborative, creative and user centric approach to data to do good and solve difficult problems. Ensuring that our outputs are transparent, robust, and transformative. We value discussion and debate as part of our approach. We will question assumptions, ambition, and process - but do so with respect and humility.

We relish difficult problems, and overcome them with innovation, creativity, and technical freedom to help us design optimum solutions. Ethics, privacy, and quality are at the heart of our work, and we will not sacrifice these for outcomes.

We treat data with respect and use it only for the right purpose. Our people are positive, dedicated, and relentless. Data is a vast topic, but we strive for interactions that are engaging, informative and fun in equal measure. But maintain a steely focus on outcomes and delivering quality products for our customers.

We are passionate about our people; we want our colleagues to develop the things they are good at and enjoy.

By joining us you can expect

Autonomy to develop and grow your skills and experience
Be part of exciting project work that is making a difference in society
Strong, inspiring, and thought-provoking leadership
A supportive and collaborative environment

As well as this, we offer:

Annual two-day technical hackathon bringing together all technical teams for innovation and collaboration
Monthly Engineering & Architecture Community of Practice event
Bi-annual whole company teambuilding events bringing everyone together for a day of fun and connection
Development access to Pluralsight and LinkedIn Learning
Volunteering - 2 paid days per year to volunteer in our local communities or within a charity organisation
Private Medical Insurance which is non-contributory (spouse and dependants included)
Worldwide Travel Insurance which is non-contributory (spouse and dependants included)
Discretionary Company Bonus based on company and individual performance
Life Assurance of 4 times base salary
Time off - 25 days of annual leave a year, plus bank holidays, with the option to buy 5 extra days each year
Pension Salary Exchange Scheme with 4% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution
Wellness 24/7 Confidential employee assistance programme
Social - office parties, pizza Friday and commitment to charitable causes

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Utveckla framtiden med oss!

Omegapoint är ett ledande cybersäkerhetsföretag som arbetar med säker digitalisering. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med branchens mest erfarna experter. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar säkra system tillsammans med våra kunder och nu söker vi fler vassa utvecklare till Stockholm.

Om rollen

I denna roll blir du en viktig spelare i vårt team och vi tror därför att du är en lagspelare med högt ansvarstagande och kvalitetstänk. Du trivs i kundnära relationer där du är en strukturerad och engagerad rådgivare och har förmåga att omsätta dina kunskaper i konkreta lösningar. Du agerar självständigt och tar egna initiativ.

För att trivas hos oss är du mer än en utvecklare, du är en teknisk problemlösare med ett brett perspektiv. Du är nyfiken på hur AI och ny teknik förändrar vårt sätt att bygga system och arbeta i team, och du vill vara med och forma hur dessa verktyg används för att skapa smartare, säkrare och mer värdeskapande lösningar. Du testar gärna nya arbetssätt och delar med dig av insikter till andra.

Vi tror att du:

Har minst fyra års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och en utbildning inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande.
Har god vana av att arbeta i Java, C#/.NET eller liknande språk i moderna utvecklingsmiljöer.
Har erfarenhet av distribuerade system, containerplattformar och eventdrivna arkitekturer (exempelvis Kubernetes och Kafka/RabbitMQ).
Är bekväm med testdriven utveckling, automatiserade tester och att bygga robusta, långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.
Har arbetat med CI/CD, IaC och DevOps/DevSecOps-principer i praktiken.
Ser AI som en naturlig del av modernt utvecklingsarbete och använder AI-baserade verktyg där de skapar värde. Du har ett säkerhetsmedvetet förhållningssätt och förstår vikten av att använda AI på ett ansvarsfullt och genomtänkt sätt.
Behärskar svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift.

Utveckla med AI i praktiken

På Omegapoint ser vi AI som en naturlig del av modern systemutveckling. Vi tror att framtidens digitala lösningar skapas när mänsklig kompetens, erfarenhet och omdöme möter artificiell intelligens.

Hos oss får du tillgång till moderna AI-verktyg som hjälper dig att skapa smartare, säkrare och mer värdeskapande lösningar. Vi uppmuntrar nyfikenhet, lärande och kunskapsdelning och värdesätter alltid säkerhet och kvalitet. I uppdrag med särskilda säkerhetskrav arbetar vi med lösningar och miljöer som ger den kontroll och trygghet som krävs.

Tillsammans med vassa och snälla kollegor formar du framtidens säkra digitala lösningar och bidrar till en framtid där människor kan lita på tekniken. 

Vi satsar på dig

Hos oss sätter vi din kompetens i centrum och ger dig alla förutsättningar för ett utvecklande och varierat jobb:

Utveckling och aktiviteter: vi ordnar regelbundet aktiviteter på vårt kontor på Vasagatan i Stockholm för att vi ska utvecklas och ha roligt tillsammans. Vi har bland annat en egen idrottsförening och festkommitté.
Kompetenskultur: vi samarbetar, delar kunskap och stärker varandra. Årliga kompetenskonferenser är ett självklart inslag. En gång i månaden har vi även Kompetensdag på kontoret.
Spännande uppdrag: vår kundbas sträcker sig från små specialistföretag till stora välkända företag och myndigheter, vilket ger både utmanande och roliga projekt.
Förmåner och trygghet: vi erbjuder marknadsmässiga löner, förstärkt föräldralön, anpassade förmånspaket, friskvårdsbidrag och sjukvårdsförsäkring.

Men viktigast av allt – vi har en kultur där vi utvecklas tillsammans, delar kunskap och har riktigt roligt längs vägen.

💚 Om oss

Omegapoint är norra Europas ledande konsultbolag inom säker digital innovation. Vi är över 800 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Örebro, Västerås, Enköping, Uppsala och Umeå.

new_jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Loyalty management
new_jobs.description:
We are super excited to announce that Jimmy Sigwid is looking for our next Staff Software Engineer
to join our Data & Integrations product area and Team Points.

Our mission is to make loyalty, incentives and customer data scalable, reliable and actionable across Voyado’s platform. Behind that mission are systems handling business-critical transactions and data for some of the world’s leading brands — and as Voyado and our customers grow, so do the technical challenges we need to solve.

A key focus going forward is evolving our platform architecture to support greater scale, stronger domain ownership and more independent services. This means working with everything from distributed systems and data consistency to event-driven architecture and service boundaries.

About The Role

The Points team owns the systems behind how consumers earn and use loyalty points and rewards across Voyado’s retail customers. Whether someone earns points from a purchase, uses them towards a reward, or interacts with a loyalty program across different channels, our services help make that experience possible.

These are business-critical systems that need to remain fast, reliable and consistent as transaction volumes and use cases grow.

Right now, the team is in the middle of an exciting technical transition. We are evolving parts of the architecture to handle greater scale, reduce dependencies between domains and make it easier for teams to evolve their services independently. A large part of this means moving towards more event-driven and service-oriented patterns and rethinking how services and data interact.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll be one of the technical drivers behind that evolution. You’ll work hands-on with backend development and distributed systems while helping the team make architectural decisions that need to hold up over time.

The role combines deep technical work with technical leadership. You’ll drive complex initiatives, mentor other engineers and collaborate across teams to improve both our platform and the way we build software.

So, who are you?

We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical depth with the ability to influence technical direction beyond their immediate team.

You enjoy taking ownership of complex technical problems where the solution isn’t always obvious. You’re comfortable creating clarity, evaluating trade-offs and bringing other engineers along in the direction you propose — while still staying close to the code.

You don’t need experience from our exact stack, but we believe you have worked with several of the following:

Backend development in C#, .NET, Java, Kotlin, Go, or similar
Distributed systems, cloud-native services and event-driven architectures
REST APIs, asynchronous workflows and message-based systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus
SQL databases, transactional consistency and scalable data handling
Observability, automated testing and secure engineering practices

We Also Think You

Enjoy driving technical direction and improving engineering practices
Are comfortable mentoring and supporting other engineers
Can lead technical initiatives that span teams or domains
Use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and see AI-assisted engineering as an important capability going forward as we continue our journey toward becoming AI-native

Experience with high-volume transactional systems
, such as fintech, payments, loyalty or similar domains, is a strong plus — but previous retail experience is not required.

What's in it for you?

Voyado Wouldn’t Be The Powerful Platform It Is Without The People Behind It. We Really Care For Our Voyadoers And Some Examples Of What We Can Offer You Are

An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.

Some Of Our Benefits

30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
Breakfast buffet on Fridays
Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
A wellness hour you can use every week

About Voyado

Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.

With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.

Be yourself 🏳️‍🌈

At Voyado, we believe in gender equality. We are proud sponsors of Womengineer as well as Tjejer Kodar! Read more about Tjejer Kodar & Voyado here

Equality is not only about gender but also about making everyone feel welcome and heard in a multicultural and diverse environment. We at Voyado strive to make everyone feel like they can bring their true self to work every day. Gender-equal and diverse teams have more perspectives on life and bring different ideas to the table which in the end leads not only to making a better working environment but also a better product.

Ready to find out more?

Lovely! 🎉

Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!

Making it personal with AI

We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.

Note: As of right now we are unable to proceed with applicants outside of the EU, and a requirement of eligibility to work at Voyado is the right to work in the EU without limitations. Needless to say, this is something we are actively working on to be able to onboard colleagues from all over the world.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Forward Deployed Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Forward Deployed Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB.

Such transformations are time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Forward Deployed Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB’s R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Application Modernization Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernisation projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

Our ideal candidate will have

4+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients
Proficiency in Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages
Strong knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations
Experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases
Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable
Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems
Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings
Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus. That includes Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, and OpenAI APIs
And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

Position Expectations

Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption
Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organisation
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap
Personally execute POCs including developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations
Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols
Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams
Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers
Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month, which includes regional travel (within Europe)

Success Measures

The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products
Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering
Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences
Provide unique insight into customer needs, product requirements and strategic opportunities by contributing experience from the field
Gain the reputation as a trusted advisor with our field teams and customers
Contribute to the success of customer application migration initiatives that they support

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

new_jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Investing Systems
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

THE TEAM

The Investment Technology group at KKR builds and operates the systems that power the entire investment lifecycle, from deal sourcing and portfolio construction to risk management and monetization. We design platforms that connect data, people, and insights across Private Equity, Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure, and Capital Markets, enabling investment teams to make faster, smarter decisions at scale. Our mandate is to transform how KKR invests by engineering shared, data-driven platforms that replace fragmented legacy tools with integrated solutions that drive efficiency, transparency, and alpha generation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As part of our continued investment in Ireland, KKR is launching a Technology & Engineering Centre of Excellence in Dublin. This new hub will play a central role in building the world’s first technology platform engineered to manage over one trillion dollars in alternative AUM (assets under management.) Designed from the ground up for scale, security and speed, this is the infrastructure for the future of global finance. Areas of focus include investment technology, portfolio construction and management, liquidity solutions, risk analytics, and advanced data platforms.

This is an exceptional opportunity to join a growing team within one of the world’s leading investment firms. You will contribute to high-visibility, strategic initiatives that are critical to the success of KKR’s business, working alongside a talented group professionals.

We’re committed to attracting and developing top-tier technology talent in Ireland. We’re looking for exceptional engineers who are passionate about innovation, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to work on some of the most interesting challenges in financial technology. We need you to help establish this team’s reputation for excellence and leadership.

THE ROLE

As a Principal Engineer, you will define the technical vision for key parts of our stack, shaping how data, analytics, and applications come together to drive business value.

You’ll combine deep engineering expertise with a strategic mindset—designing scalable systems, mentoring top talent, and setting standards for technical excellence. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering, data, and finance.

Our stack includes AWS, Postgres, Python, and React, with an emphasis on AI-assisted development and automation to enhance speed and quality across the SDLC.

Responsibilities

Work at the scope of the Investment Systems group to drive Architecture and Technical Strategy: Define and evolve the architecture for complex, cloud-native systems that support KKR’s investment operations.
Shape Engineering Practices: Establish standards for design, testing, observability, and CI/CD across multiple teams.
Drive Innovation: Identify and introduce new tools, frameworks, and AI-driven approaches that improve developer efficiency and data insights.
Mentor and Grow Talent: Coach engineers at all levels, cultivating technical depth, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Deliver Measurable Impact: Align technology initiatives to business objectives, tracking progress and outcomes.
Champion Reliability and Security: Ensure systems are built for resilience, performance, and compliance.
Influence Talent Decisions: Play a key role in recruiting and retaining top engineering talent through technical leadership and cultural alignment.

Who We Are Looking For

~12+ years of professional software engineering experience, exhibiting technical leadership across complex, distributed systems.
Proven success designing and scaling cloud-based platforms (AWS experience strongly preferred).
Expertise in one or more object-oriented languages (Python, Java, C++, etc) and strong familiarity with modern front-end frameworks such as React.
Solid understanding of database technologies (SQL & NoSQL), with experience in optimizing data models, caching, and performance.
Proficient in leveraging AI tools within the developer workflow to enhance productivity.
Effective communicator who can connect technical vision to business goals.
Experienced mentor who elevates the skills and judgment of others.
Curiosity and enthusiasm for finance and investment technology.
Strategic thinker who values simplicity, automation, and measurable results.
Proven record of ownership, able to deliver in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment, with exceptional attention to detail.
