new_jobs.title: AI Workflow Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About us

We build the KeyShot, one of the leading 3D rendering products in the world, used across product design, engineering, marketing, and manufacturing to visualize and communicate ideas even before they're real. Used by companies like Google, Rolex, Louis Vuitton, HP, Microsoft, Philips, Adidas, and many more.

You'll be joining our cross functional web team, that builds the web services that expand KeyShot Studio for its users — powering collaboration, effective workflows, and the infrastructure that lets people work with renderings the way that suits them. We're growing this team to keep pushing that experience forward.

What you'll do

Design and set up AI workflows for implementing backend services in TypeScript, running on AWS
Retain high quality in an increasingly AI-driven development process - having strong review practices and keep tests quality.
Work within a microservice architecture, building services that are reliable and observable
Own your code through our CI/CD pipelines, and treat our test suite as a first-class part of the job
Build the services that give KeyShot users and collaborators smooth, reliable workflows - from SSO, integrations with Studio, Cloud Rendering to collaboration features
Collaborate closely with your team - reviewing code, finding solutions, share your insights and taking shared ownership of outcomes rather than working in solitude

What we're looking for

Experience designing and running AI-driven development workflows - using agentic coding tools (like Claude Code) to build and ship real production software
A track record of keeping quality high while working AI-first: reviewing, verifying, and course-correcting AI-generated code rather than accepting it at face value
Solid experience with TypeScript in a backend context
Experience with AWS cloud services and cloud architecture best practices (Infrastructure as Code like CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform is a plus)
Comfort working in a microservice architecture - working with serverless and event-driven application design (Lambda, DynamoDB, or similar)
Experience with CI/CD and a genuine belief that a strong automated test suite is the foundation for moving quickly on top of a robust foundation
A collaborative, self-driven working style - we don't manage tightly, but we rely on people to bring initiative and support their teammates in equal measure
You're past needing close guidance on how to do the job, and you're looking for a team where your judgment is trusted
Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken - our colleagues come from all over the world and English is our primary working language

What you'll join

You'll join a 8 person team of backend, frontend, and QA engineers, most based in our Aarhus Office, building the web services around KeyShot. We run flat and self-driven, valuing finding the solutions as a team. We back your development with real structure: biweekly 1:1s and an ongoing growth plan, so you keep developing.

Beyond the work, we offer health insurance, good maternity leave terms and a pension program as standard. On top of that: lunch scheme, massage, foosball, and regular social events.

Application and Interest

We are looking for candidates based in Aarhus, Odense, or Copenhagen. If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you! Got any questions? Feel free to reach out to Steffen Østerby Muldbjerg at steffen.muldbjerg@keyshot.com .

new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

DEVELOPER INTERN

Merkle Aarhus, a Dentsu Company

SPRING 2027

Do you want to go on a journey in one of Denmark's largest digital bureaus? Do you like to build robust backend systems the right way, and do you have a flair for writing code? Then this might be something for you!

Being an intern at Merkle will give you a lot of opportunities to evolve within e-commerce and platform development. You will be a fully integrated developer in a unique team of backend developers, frontend developers, QA's, and our clients and stakeholders. A team where we help each other finishing the tasks, in a sometimes busy day. You will have a mentor, who will help onboarding you and help you feel ready for the tasks as a developer at Merkle.

What You'll Be Working On

You'll join Merkle's Aarhus software team to help develop an API Management system exposing endpoints from a marketplace for aircraft spare parts. You'll work primarily on the Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), handling users and applications against a database, running in Azure.

Methods and technologies

Java & Spring Boot
REST API development
Docker & Azure deployments
SCRUM & Jira, and agile methods
Git
CI/CD and version control workflows
Unit testing and automated E2E testing

Tasks And Responsibilities

Build and maintain backend solutions in Java/Spring Boot, including REST endpoints and integration with external services
Gain practical experience with unit tests, automated E2E testing, and debugging
Learn how a modern API Management system fits together (frontend, BFF, database, and platforms such as SAP APIM and Entra ID)
Understand the professional development process, from business requirements to running code via version control, code review, and CI/CD
Collaborate through pair programming and agile methods, contributing your own solution proposals

Personal And Professional Skills

You come from a relevant education in IT and software development
You are curious and willing to learn
You are engaging and open, and can work both independently and in teams
You are thorough, professional, and quality minded

Backend development and API management are becoming a bigger and bigger part of our company, and right now we are growing every year. As an intern you will get a lot of interesting and challenging tasks. You will get great knowledge of modern software development methods, cloud deployment, and of how it is to work in an innovative company. It is very important to us that you learn a lot, evolve personally, and that we have fun while doing it. There will be an opportunity to be hired afterwards if it is a great match.

About Merkle

Merkle is the strong combination of local and global. We are more than 200 colleagues here in Denmark and part of Merkle worldwide with more than 11,000 people. Merkle is a leader in data-driven customer experience management (CXM), and we deliver unique, personalized customer experiences across channels and devices.

We are also part of dentsu – a global agency network with more than 46,000 dedicated employees in 145 markets. But size isn't everything. At Merkle, our mission is to help our clients provide their customers with the best experiences possible. More than anything, this requires skills, passion and cooperation.

We provide expertise in customer experience strategy and consulting, user experience design, CRM, data management, commerce, mobile, content management systems (CMS), adtech and martech platforms.

Where, when and how?

We are located at the center of Aarhus with a nice office at Åboulevarden 18, 2. sal, 8000 Aarhus C.

The internship will be from mid-January and for the following 3–4 months, and in that period, there will also be time to make your project in cooperation with Merkle. The internship is fulltime and unpaid - but we do offer a lot of social events, lots of learning opportunities and free breakfast and lunch.

Is your heart racing a little now? If you can see yourself in all this - both the internship and being part of Merkle - don't hesitate. Send us your CV and application as soon as possible.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Build the enterprise platforms that power intelligent operations.

Join Agilent's Global OT & AI Engineering organization and help develop the cloud-native platforms that connect enterprise systems, manufacturing operations, and intelligent digital solutions across Agilent's global operations.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, enterprise APIs, integration platforms, and cloud-native applications that enable secure, reliable, and real-time information exchange across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence.

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Data Engineers, AI & Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will develop the enterprise services that power digital products, operational analytics, AI applications, and connected manufacturing systems.

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

About Global OT & AI Engineering

Global OT & AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.

Our organization combines software engineering, enterprise data platforms, Artificial Intelligence, industrial automation, cloud technologies, and Smart Factory solutions to build scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision-making, and enable continuous improvement across global operations.

Our mission is to build the digital operating system for intelligent manufacturing.

Our portfolio includes:

Global Operations Control Tower
Enterprise Data Platform (GOLake)
AI & Decision Intelligence Platform
Smart Factory Applications
Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
Enterprise KPI Platform
Digital Twin Solutions
Manufacturing Data Exchange Platform
AI-powered Digital Coworkers

About The Role

Modern enterprise software depends on reliable, scalable, and secure platform services that connect business applications, operational technologies, enterprise systems, and cloud services into a unified digital ecosystem.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will build the backend capabilities that power Agilent's digital products. From enterprise APIs and integration services to cloud-native microservices and event-driven architectures, your work will provide the foundation that enables seamless communication between applications, data platforms, AI services, and manufacturing systems.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop reusable platform capabilities that accelerate software delivery, improve system reliability, and support Agilent's long-term digital transformation strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Services Development

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that support enterprise digital products.
Build reusable APIs, microservices, and shared platform capabilities that accelerate software development across multiple applications.
Develop secure and maintainable services that enable reliable communication between enterprise systems and operational platforms.
Ensure platform services are scalable, resilient, and designed for long-term maintainability.

Enterprise Integration

Develop integration services connecting ERP, MES, PLM, Quality Systems, AI platforms, enterprise applications, and cloud services.
Design API-first solutions that promote reuse and simplify system integration.
Implement event-driven and asynchronous communication patterns to improve scalability and responsiveness.
Enable secure and efficient information exchange across enterprise and manufacturing environments.

Cloud-Native Engineering

Develop cloud-native applications and services using modern architectural patterns.
Support containerized deployments, automated testing, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).
Optimize platform performance, reliability, scalability, and operational resilience.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities that improve platform health and operational support.

Security & Reliability

Apply secure software development practices throughout the application lifecycle.
Implement authentication, authorization, and API security standards.
Support disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and high-availability strategies.
Continuously improve platform performance through proactive monitoring and optimization.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Application Experience Engineers to deliver end-to-end enterprise applications.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to expose trusted enterprise data through secure services.
Work with AI & Data Scientists to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
Support Smart Factory Engineers by enabling secure integration between operational technologies and enterprise applications.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and Agile delivery activities.

Technology Environment

You will have opportunities to work with modern enterprise technologies including:

Backend Development

.NET
Python
Node.js (preferred)

API & Integration

REST APIs
GraphQL (preferred)
gRPC (preferred)
OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect

Cloud Platforms

Microsoft Azure
AWS

Containers & DevOps

Docker
Kubernetes
Azure DevOps
GitHub Actions

Messaging & Event Streaming

Apache Kafka
Azure Event Hub
RabbitMQ (preferred)

Databases

SQL Server
PostgreSQL
MongoDB
Redis (preferred)

Monitoring & Observability

Azure Monitor
Application Insights
Grafana
Prometheus (preferred)

Qualifications

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.

You should have:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Experience developing backend applications, APIs, or enterprise software platforms.
Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as C#, Python, or Java.
Understanding of API development, system integration, and relational databases.
Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and distributed application architecture.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Passion for building scalable software platforms that enable enterprise digital transformation.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is advantageous:

Cloud-native application development (Azure or AWS)
Microservices architecture
Event-driven architecture
Container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
Enterprise Integration Patterns
CI/CD and DevOps practices
Identity and Access Management (IAM)
Manufacturing or industrial software platforms

Leadership Competencies

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

Strong software engineering and systems design fundamentals.
Passion for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable software platforms.
Customer-focused problem solving with a commitment to delivering business value.
Excellent collaboration across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.
Curiosity to explore emerging technologies and modern engineering practices.
Ability to balance technical excellence with pragmatic business outcomes.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule.

Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

Agilent Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Location: Remote - Romania

Employment: 3-Month Contract

Rate: $180-200 RON Per Hour

Insight Global is seeking a Senior .NET Software Engineer to support a large-scale enterprise application modernization initiative. This individual will play a key role in transitioning critical business applications from a legacy Java/ADF environment to a modern .NET ecosystem. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with deep expertise in C#, ASP.NET Core, software architecture, and enterprise application development.

This role will be responsible for leading development efforts, mentoring engineers through a technology transition, establishing engineering best practices, and partnering closely with business and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise web applications using C#, ASP.NET Core MVC, and .NET

Drive the modernization of legacy Java/ADF applications into a scalable and maintainable .NET architecture

Develop new application features and capabilities while ensuring functional parity during system migrations

Partner with architects to define application architecture, API strategies, and database design standards

Design and develop RESTful APIs integrated with Oracle and other relational databases

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Join us at Wolters Kluwer and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day. We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most.

We are currently looking for a Senior Product Software Engineer
to join our team.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will work as a full-time Full Stack Developer within a hybrid work model, contributing to the design, development, and evolution of scalable software solutions.

This role requires strong hands-on technical expertise, the ability to work independently with minimal guidance, and accountability for delivering high-quality solutions within a modern, cloud-based, microservices-oriented architecture.

At this level, engineers are expected to solve complex technical problems, apply best practices, and act as a technical reference for peers while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities:

End-to-End Software Development Design, develop, test, and maintain full stack applications using modern backend and frontend technologies, ensuring high quality, performance, and maintainability.
Backend Development & Architecture Build and evolve RESTful APIs and microservices based on .NET (.NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API, C#), applying OOP, SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Clean Code practices within decoupled architectures.
Frontend Development Develop and maintain rich web applications using Angular, ensuring usability, performance, and alignment with backend services.
Asynchronous Communication & Messaging Design and implement asynchronous workflows using RabbitMQ, MassTransit, and Azure Service Bus, ensuring reliability and scalability.
Data Management & Caching Work with SQL-based relational databases and Redis to ensure efficient data storage, access, and caching strategies.
Testing & Quality Assurance Implement and maintain unit and integration tests, contributing to robust testing frameworks and ensuring system reliability.
CI/CD & Automation Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, YAML pipelines, Git, supporting automated builds, testing, and deployments.
Cloud & Containerization Deploy and operate applications using Docker and Kubernetes, contributing to scalable and resilient cloud-native solutions.
Technical Problem Solving Analyze complex technical issues, evaluate multiple solutions, and apply sound judgment to resolve problems effectively.
Monitoring & Traceability Experience with application performance monitoring (APM), observability and tracing tools like Datadog or Grafana.
Collaboration & Communication Work closely with product, QA, and other engineering teams; explain complex technical topics clearly and contribute to alignment and consensus.
Knowledge Sharing & Team Impact Act as a technical resource for team members, sharing best practices and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience:

Core Technical Skills:

Strong experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer
Advanced knowledge of:
C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API
Angular
RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
SQL and relational database design
Redis
Asynchronous messaging systems (RabbitMQ, MassTransit, Azure Service Bus)

Solid understanding of:
OOP, SOLID principles
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
Clean Code practices

Engineering Practices:

Unit and integration testing frameworks
Git, GitHub, and collaborative source code management
CI/CD with Azure DevOps and YAML pipelines
Containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes
Hands-on experience with monitoring and traceability ecosystems (e.g., Datadog, Grafana).
Agile methodologies (Scrum / Kanban)

Competencies:

Analytical Thinking – Ability to break down complex problems and design effective solutions.
Functional & Operational Expertise – Deep technical knowledge applied pragmatically to real-world systems.
Accountability – Ownership of deliverables and ongoing technical responsibilities.
Inclusive Collaboration – Works effectively with diverse roles and teams.
Drive to Perform – Focus on quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

If you think that you have the needed requirements click on the apply button to join us and be the difference
. If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or any other protected status, in accordance with local regulations.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.
